# GraphQL Schema - `agg-garage-graph`

> GraphQL aggregation gateway cho Garage web/mobile. Service compose schema từ các module trong repo `agg-garage-graph`, không own database, và forward/orchestrate request sang downstream REST services.
>
> Tài liệu này được rà soát lại từ mã nguồn hiện tại. SDL trong `src/graphql/**/**/*.schema.ts` vẫn là source of truth khi implementation thay đổi.

## §0 Wave Index

> **Subagent RULE (bounded read)**: nếu prompt scope gắn với 1 wave cụ thể, subagent chỉ được `Read` các section liệt kê ở cột `Sections` của wave đó **+ §1 Thông tin chung + §4 Naming conventions/registry references**. **KHÔNG đọc toàn file** (47k+ dòng). Nếu cần cross-wave check thì đọc thêm section wave lân cận theo bảng.
>
> **Cascading rule**: khi ratify thêm 1 sub-module `§3<letter>` cho wave mới, MUST append 1 hàng vào bảng này **trong cùng commit**. Drift check: `scripts/check-api-wave-index-drift.sh` (warn-only). Vi phạm = FM-020.

## 1. Thông tin chung

| Thuộc tính | Giá trị |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | Public `${GRAPHQL_PUBLIC_PATH}/graphql`, default `/graphql/graphql`; internal `${GRAPHQL_INTERNAL_PATH}`, default `/playground` |
| Auth | Forward `Authorization` xuống downstream; gateway không issue JWT và không own authorization nghiệp vụ. |
| API style | GraphQL over HTTP JSON, multipart upload khi có scalar `Upload` |
| Runtime | Node.js 22 / TypeScript / Express / Apollo Server 4 / `@graphql-tools/schema` |
| Transport | GraphQL operations dùng `POST /graphql`; client phân biệt bằng `operationName` và `variables`. Ngoài ra có 11 REST endpoints cho binary download/export + health/metrics + Superset proxy (xem §3a). |
| Downstream | `gf-sales`, `gf-purchase`, `gf-inventory`, `gf-erp-mdm`, `gf-customer`, `gf-marketing`, `gf-notification`, `gf-accounting`, `gf-hrms`, `policy-agent`, `gf-system`, `ct-file-storage`, `ct-saas-tenant`, `ac-payment-gateway`, Superset |
| Error model | GraphQL errors ở top-level `errors[]`; business/downstream errors thường đi trong union `ErrorResponse`. |

## 3. Endpoint Details

Các API dưới đây có cùng HTTP transport `POST /graphql`. Request/response thể hiện đúng operation signature, variables và return wrapper theo SDL. Với union response, client luôn nên query `__typename` và branch theo success type hoặc `ErrorResponse`.

### Subscription `_heartbeat`

Module: `common/base`. Return type: `String`.

**Transport**: GraphQL subscription.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent; gateway forward headers theo request context khi subscription transport duoc cau hinh.
**Behavior**: Resolver phat timestamp ISO moi 30 giay.

**Subscription**:
```graphql
subscription heartbeat {
  _heartbeat
}
```

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document không parse được. |
| `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document/variables không khớp SDL. |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Input không hợp lệ theo scalar/custom validation. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` | 401 | Thiếu hoặc không resolve được bearer token khi operation/downstream yêu cầu auth. |
| `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 403 | Downstream hoặc authorization layer từ chối quyền. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 408 | Request downstream timeout dạng request timeout. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Request downstream timeout dạng gateway/connect timeout. |
| `HTTP_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả HTTP error không có structured body. |
| `API_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả structured error nhưng không có `code`; gateway gán fallback. |
| `<downstream code>` | downstream | Nếu downstream trả `{ code, message, ... }`, gateway preserve nguyên `code` trong `ErrorResponse.code`. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` | 500 | Lỗi không phải Axios/GraphQL đã biết trong resolver/service. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback default error response trong error plugin/factory. |

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document không parse được. |
| `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document/variables không khớp SDL. |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Input không hợp lệ theo scalar/custom validation. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` | 401 | Thiếu hoặc không resolve được bearer token khi operation/downstream yêu cầu auth. |
| `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 403 | Downstream hoặc authorization layer từ chối quyền. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 408 | Request downstream timeout dạng request timeout. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Request downstream timeout dạng gateway/connect timeout. |
| `HTTP_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả HTTP error không có structured body. |
| `API_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả structured error nhưng không có `code`; gateway gán fallback. |
| `<downstream code>` | downstream | Nếu downstream trả `{ code, message, ... }`, gateway preserve nguyên `code` trong `ErrorResponse.code`. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` | 500 | Lỗi không phải Axios/GraphQL đã biết trong resolver/service. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback default error response trong error plugin/factory. |

  "query": "query getWarehouseByCode($warehouseCode: String!) { getWarehouseByCode(warehouseCode: $warehouseCode) { __typename ... on ApiResponseWarehouseResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename id tenantId branchCode warehouseCode warehouseName warehouseType address city ward contactPhone contactEmail isDefault isActive createdBy createdAt updatedBy updatedAt } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "warehouseCode": "String-sample"
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "getWarehouseByCode": {
      "__typename": "ErrorResponse",
      "code": "<gateway-or-downstream-code>",
      "message": "<error message>",
      "statusCode": 400,
      "path": "<downstream path or GraphQL path>",
      "timestamp": "2026-05-12T09:30:00Z"
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document không parse được. |
| `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | GraphQL document/variables không khớp SDL. |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Input không hợp lệ theo scalar/custom validation. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` | 401 | Thiếu hoặc không resolve được bearer token khi operation/downstream yêu cầu auth. |
| `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 403 | Downstream hoặc authorization layer từ chối quyền. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 408 | Request downstream timeout dạng request timeout. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Request downstream timeout dạng gateway/connect timeout. |
| `HTTP_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả HTTP error không có structured body. |
| `API_ERROR` | downstream | Downstream trả structured error nhưng không có `code`; gateway gán fallback. |
| `<downstream code>` | downstream | Nếu downstream trả `{ code, message, ... }`, gateway preserve nguyên `code` trong `ErrorResponse.code`. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` | 500 | Lỗi không phải Axios/GraphQL đã biết trong resolver/service. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback default error response trong error plugin/factory. |

## 3a. REST Endpoints (Non-GraphQL)

Ngoài GraphQL endpoint, gateway expose các REST endpoint cho binary download/export, health check, metrics và Superset proxy:

| # | Method | Path | Downstream | Purpose |
|---|--------|------|------------|---------|
| R-1 | GET | `/health` | — | Liveness probe: status, timestamp, uptime; non-prod echo env |
| R-2 | GET | `/metrics` | — | Prometheus metrics scrape (collectDefaultMetrics + OTEL) |
| R-3 | GET | `/graphql/download` | ct-file-storage | File download proxy via uploadFileHandlers.downloadFile |
| R-4 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/service-orders/:id/export-pdf` | gf-sales | Service order PDF export passthrough |
| R-5 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/service-orders/:id/export-image` | gf-sales | Service order image export passthrough |
| R-6 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/receipts/export` | gf-inventory | Receipt Excel export passthrough |
| R-7 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/deliveries/export` | gf-inventory | Delivery Excel export passthrough |
| R-8 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/deliveries/:id/export-pdf` | gf-inventory | Delivery PDF export passthrough |
| R-9 | GET | `/graphql/api/v2/receipts/:id/export-pdf` | gf-inventory | Receipt PDF export passthrough |
| R-10 | GET | `/graphql/api/v1/settlements/:id/export-pdf` | gf-accounting | Settlement PDF export passthrough |
| R-11 | ANY | `/*` | Superset | Catch-all proxy sang Apache Superset; pathRewrite `^/supperset` → `''`; allowlist bypass cho `/graphql/*`, `/playground/*`, `/health`, `/download`, `/metrics`, `*export-*` |


## 3b. Multi-Downstream Endpoint Detail Tree (Static Analysis)

> **Phương pháp**: Static analysis từ source code `agg-garage-graph` — các file `src/graphql/modules/**/*.resolver.ts`, `src/utils/helper.ts`, và các handler/service liên quan. Mỗi operation dưới đây gọi >= 2 downstream REST API trong cùng một resolver function, bao gồm cả conditional calls, helper calls (catalog hierarchy, tenant user enrichment), và downstream gọi nhiều lần.
>
> **Format**: Cây cha-con, grouped theo module. Mỗi operation cha có parent request/response tổng. Mỗi downstream child ghi rõ service, endpoint, điều kiện gọi, nguồn dữ liệu request, response sử dụng phần nào, và cách merge vào parent.
>
> **Lưu ý về parent samples**: Nếu parent GraphQL request/response đã có trong §3 Endpoint Details, section này tái sử dụng đúng sample đó (chỉ ghi reference để tránh lệch schema và giảm kích thước file).

### 3b.0a Downstream Enrichment Patterns

Nhiều operation sử dụng các pattern enrichment chung. Tham chiếu pattern này trong tree detail để giảm lặp:

**Pattern CATALOG-FIND**: Gọi `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/find-by-code` với mảng codes. Trả về `data[].{code, name, ...}`. Dùng để enrichment vehicle brand/model/year/version, unit names, insurance names, address names.

**Pattern CATALOG-HIERARCHY**: Gọi `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/get-hierarchy` với vehicle object `{carBrand, carModel, yearOfManufacture, trimsLevel}`. Trả về vehicle hierarchy items.

**Pattern CATALOG-HIERARCHY-LIST**: Gọi `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/get-hierarchy-list` với mảng `[{id, carBrand, carModel, ...}]`. Trả về mapped hierarchy per item id.

**Pattern TENANT-USERS**: Gọi `ct-saas-tenant POST /api/v1/saas-tenant/tenant-users/search/basic` với `{iamUserIds, tenantId}`. tenantId extract từ JWT. Trả về `data.content[].{iamUserId, fullName}`. Dùng để map *By fields (createdBy, updatedBy, ...) sang fullName.

**Pattern CATALOG-CREATE**: Gọi `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/create-hierarchy` với vehicle info strings. Trả về CatalogHierarchyItem objects.

```

├─ [2] **gf-erp-mdm** POST /api/v1/catalog/get-hierarchy
│ **Khi nào**: Conditional — chỉ gọi khi `result.data` tồn tại (có askedVehicle)

│ }

│  "data": {
│   "content": [
│    { "code": "STL-001" }
│   ]
│  }
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: data.content[].code
│ **Merge**: Set data.linkedSettlements = content.map(s => {code: s.code})

  **Khi nào**: Conditional — data.creatorEmployeeId là truthy

### 3b.13 Module: direct-purchase-order

#### 3b.13.1 [Query] `searchDirectPurchaseOrders`

**Module**: direct-purchase-order | **Downstream calls**: 2

> **Parent Request/Response**: xem §3 `searchDirectPurchaseOrders`

**Downstream Tree**:

```
├─ [1] **gf-purchase** GET /api/v3/purchase-order/search
│ **Khi nào**: Always
│ **Request source**: GraphQL args `input` được map thành query params (page, size, keyword, status, ...)

│ ```

│ {
│  "data": {
│   "content": [
│    { "id": 101, "code": "DPO-001", "carBrand": "BRAND_001", "carModel": "MODEL_002", "status": "APPROVED" }
│   ],
│   "totalElements": 1
│  }
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: `data.content[].{id, carBrand, carModel}` — dùng làm input cho call [2]
│ **Merge**: Kết quả là parent response chính, sau đó được enrich bởi call [2]
│
└─ [2] **gf-erp-mdm** POST /api/v1/catalog/get-hierarchy-list
  **Khi nào**: Always (chi chạy khi `content` có items có carBrand/carModel)

  [
   { "id": 101, "carBrand": "BRAND_001", "carModel": "MODEL_002" }
  ]
  ```

  {
   "data": [
    {

    }
   ]
  }

  **Merge**: Mỗi content item được set `carBrandData` = hierarchy carBrand object, `carModelData` = hierarchy carModel object (qua `arrayToObjectById` + assign)
```

### 3b.14 Module: gf-accounting/settlements

#### 3b.14.1 [Query] `searchSettlements`

**Module**: gf-accounting/settlements | **Downstream calls**: 3

> **Parent Request/Response**: xem §3 `searchSettlements`

**Downstream Tree**:

```
├─ [1] **gf-accounting** POST /api/v1/settlements/search
│ **Khi nào**: Always
│ **Request source**: GraphQL args `input` (SettlementSearchRequest)
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```json
│ { "keyword": "SO-001", "page": 1, "size": 20 }
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "data": {
│   "content": [
│    { "id": 1, "code": "STL-001", "serviceOrderCode": "SO-001", "status": "SETTLED" }
│   ],
│   "totalElements": 1
│  }
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: `data.content[].serviceOrderCode` — thu thập soCodes cho call [2]
│ **Merge**: Là parent response chính, được enrich bởi call [2] va [3]
│
├─ [2] **gf-sales** POST /api/v3/service-orders/find-by-codes
│ **Khi nào**: Conditional — chỉ gọi khi `soCodes` (tập hợp serviceOrderCode tu content[]) không rỗng
│ **Request source**: `soCodes` = content[].serviceOrderCode.filter(truthy)
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```json
│ { "soCodes": ["SO-001", "SO-002"] }
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "data": [
│   { "code": "SO-001", "insuranceCompany": "INS_CODE_01", "customerName": "Nguyen Van A" }
│  ]
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: `data[].{code, insuranceCompany}` — map SO by code, thu thập insuranceCodes cho call [3]
│ **Merge**: Mỗi content item có serviceOrderCode  khớp → set `item.serviceOrder = soMap.get(item.serviceOrderCode)`. Dong thời extract `insuranceCompany` codes vào Set `insuranceCodes`
│
└─ [3] **gf-erp-mdm** POST /api/v1/catalog/find-by-code — Pattern CATALOG-FIND
  **Khi nào**: Conditional — chỉ gọi khi `insuranceCodes` set có size > 0
  **Request source**: `Array.from(insuranceCodes)` — các insurance company codes từ step [2]
  **Request sample**:
  ```json
  ["INS_CODE_01", "INS_CODE_02"]
  ```
  **Response sample**:
  ```json
  {
   "data": [
    { "code": "INS_CODE_01", "name": "Bao Hiem ABC" }
   ]
  }
  ```
  **Fields used**: `data[].{code, name}`
  **Merge**: Mỗi content item có `serviceOrder.insuranceCompany`  khớp → set `serviceOrder.insuranceCompanyName = insurance.name`
```

#### 3b.14.2 [Query] `getSettlementByCode`

**Module**: gf-accounting/settlements | **Downstream calls**: 3+ (call [2] co transitive 7 downstream nội bộ)

> **Parent Request/Response**: xem §3 `getSettlementByCode`

**Downstream Tree**:

```
├─ [1] **gf-accounting** GET /api/v1/settlements/:code
│ **Khi nào**: Always
│ **Request source**: GraphQL args `code`
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```
│ GET /api/v1/settlements/STL-001
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "data": {
│   "code": "STL-001",
│   "serviceOrderCode": "SO-001",
│   "createdBy": "iam-user-001",
│   "updatedBy": "iam-user-002",
│   "settledBy": "iam-user-003",
│   "amount": 5000000
│  }
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: `data.{serviceOrderCode, createdBy, updatedBy, settledBy}` — điều kiện cho call [2] va [3]
│ **Merge**: Là parent response chính, được enrich bởi [2] va [3]
│
├─ [2] **gf-sales** via `serviceOrderV3Handlers.getServiceOrderByCode`
│ **Khi nào**: Conditional — chỉ gọi khi `settlementData.serviceOrderCode` truthy
│ **Request source**: `{ code: settlementData.serviceOrderCode }`
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```json
│ { "code": "SO-001" }
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "data": {
│   "id": 10, "code": "SO-001", "status": "COMPLETED",
│   "vehicleResponse": { "brand": "BRAND_01", "model": "MODEL_01" },
│   "insuranceCompany": "INS_01",
│   "purchaseOrders": [], "linkedDeliveries": [], "linkedSettlements": []
│  }
│ }
│ ```
│ **Fields used**: `data` — toàn bộ service order detail
│ **Merge**: Set `settlementData.serviceOrder = soResult.data`
│
│ > **LUU Y TRANSITIVE**: Handler `getServiceOrderByCode` nội bộ delegate sang `getServiceOrderByIdV3`,
│ > thuc hien toi da **7 downstream calls**:
│ > 1. `gf-sales GET /api/v3/service-orders/detail/:code` — lấy SO detail
│ > 2. `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/get-hierarchy-list` — enrich vehicle brand/model/year/version
│ > 3. `gf-erp-mdm POST /api/v1/catalog/find-by-code` — enrich insuranceCompanyName + part unit names
│ > 4. `gf-purchase GET /api/v1/direct-purchase-orders/related-service-order/:serviceOrderCode` — linked POs
│ > 5. `gf-inventory POST /api/v2/deliveries/search` — linked deliveries
│ > 6. `gf-accounting POST /api/v1/settlements/search` — linked settlements
│ > 7. `hrms GET /api/v1/employees/:id` — creator employee name (conditional: creatorEmployeeId exists)
│ >
│ > Xem chi tiết tại §3b.7 `getServiceOrderByIdV3` (operations #26-#27).
│
└─ [3] **ct-saas-tenant** POST /api/v1/saas-tenant/tenant-users/search/basic — Pattern TENANT-USERS
  **Khi nào**: Conditional — chỉ gọi khi co ít nhất 1 trong createdBy/updatedBy/settledBy
  **Request source**: `iamUserIds` = [createdBy, updatedBy, settledBy].filter(truthy); `tenantId` extract từ JWT
  **Request sample**:
  ```json
  {
   "iamUserIds": ["iam-user-001", "iam-user-002", "iam-user-003"],
   "tenantId": "tenant-123"
  }
  ```
  **Response sample**:
  ```json
  {
   "data": {
    "content": [
     { "iamUserId": "iam-user-001", "fullName": "Tran Van B" },
     { "iamUserId": "iam-user-002", "fullName": "Le Thi C" },
     { "iamUserId": "iam-user-003", "fullName": "Pham Van D" }
    ]
   }
  }
  ```
  **Fields used**: `data.content[].{iamUserId, fullName}`
  **Merge**: Map userMap[iamUserId] = user. Set `createdByName`, `updatedByName`, `settledByName` = userMap[*].fullName tương ứng
```

### 3b.19 Module: supper-set

#### 3b.19.1 [Query] `supperSetQuestToken`

**Module**: supper-set | **Downstream calls**: 3 (tat ca gọi toi **Superset external**, khong phai internal microservice)

> **Parent Request/Response**: xem §3 `supperSetQuestToken`

> **Lưu ý**: 3 calls này gọi toi Apache Superset instance ben ngoài (`${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}`), khong phai các internal garage microservices. Authentication sự dùng admin credentials từ environment variables. Cac call này CHAINED — mỗi call can kết quả từ call truoc.

**Downstream Tree**:

```
├─ [1] **Superset (external)** POST ${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}/api/v1/security/login
│ **Khi nào**: Always
│ **Request source**: Environment variables `SUPERSET_ADMIN_USERNAME`, `SUPERSET_ADMIN_PASSWORD`
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "username": "admin",
│  "password": "***",
│  "provider": "db",
│  "refresh": true
│ }
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "access_token": "eyJ...",
│  "refresh_token": "eyR..."
│ }
│ ```
│ **Headers**: Response `set-cookie` → luu lai `loginCookies`
│ **Fields used**: `data.access_token` + response cookies → truyen cho call [2] va [3]
│ **Merge**: Khong merge vào parent. Cung cap `access_token` và `cookies` cho các call tiếp theo
│
├─ [2] **Superset (external)** GET ${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}/api/v1/security/csrf_token/
│ **Khi nào**: Always (chained — can `access_token` và `cookies` từ call [1])
│ **Request source**: `access_token` tu [1], `cookies` = loginCookies.join('; ')
│ **Request sample**:
│ ```
│ GET /api/v1/security/csrf_token/
│ Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
│ Cookie: session=abc123
│ ```
│ **Response sample**:
│ ```json
│ {
│  "result": "csrf-token-value-xyz"
│ }
│ ```
│ **Headers**: Response `set-cookie` → luu lai `csrfCookies`, ket hop với `loginCookies` → `allCookies`
│ **Fields used**: `data.result` → `csrfToken`
│ **Merge**: Khong merge vào parent. Cung cap `csrfToken` và `allCookies` cho call [3]
│
└─ [3] **Superset (external)** POST ${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}/api/v1/security/guest_token/
  **Khi nào**: Always (chained — can `access_token` tu [1], `csrfToken` tu [2], `allCookies` tu [1]+[2])
  **Request source**: `access_token` + `csrfToken` + `allCookies` tu các call truoc; `dashboardId` từ GraphQL args `input.dashboardId`
  **Request sample**:
  ```json
  {
   "resources": [
    { "type": "dashboard", "id": "abc-123" }
   ],
   "rls": [],
   "user": {
    "username": "tuannguyenhuy@aggregatoricapaci.com",
    "first_name": "Tuan",
    "last_name": "Nguyen"
   }
  }
  ```
  **Request headers**:
  ```
  Content-Type: application/json
  X-CSRFToken: csrf-token-value-xyz
  Referer: ${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}
  Origin: ${SUPERSET_ENDPOINT}
  Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
  Cookie: session=abc123; csrf_token=xyz
  ```
  **Response sample**:
  ```json
  {
   "token": "guest-token-value-789"
  }
  ```
  **Fields used**: Toàn bộ response body
  **Merge**: Parent GraphQL response = `{ data: response.data, success: true, message: "Quest Token SupperSet successfully", code: "SUCCESS" }`. Typename = `QuestTokenSupperSetOutput`
```

## 3c. Insurance Settlement GraphQL Operations (DESIGN — EP-INSURANCE-SETTLEMENT)

> ⚠️ Thiết kế (ADR-014), chưa có trong source. BFF **passthrough/orchestration** — KHÔNG persistence, KHÔNG business logic (PassthroughService discipline). Forward headers `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Branch-Id` downstream. Custom scalars `DateTime`/`JSON`/`Upload`. Mỗi resolver gọi 1 downstream REST (P1) trừ widget (P2).

| # | Operation | Downstream REST | Pattern |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | `getInsuranceDebtWidget(period)` | `GET /api/v2/dashboard/insurance-debt-widget` (gf-sales) → nội bộ gọi `GET /protected/v1/insurance-debt-summary` (gf-accounting, CB-INS-008) | P1 (gf-sales tự compose) |
| 51 | `exportInsuranceDossier(settlementCode, documentTypes, acceptanceFormData?, authorizationFormData?)` | **ORCHESTRATOR 4-phase** (ADR-016 v7): GET gf-accounting `/settlements/{code}` (resolve ctx) → PARALLEL render N byte[] (① GET gf-sales `/api/v2/service-orders/{soId}/export-pdf?type=QUOTATION` + ② GET gf-accounting `/api/v1/settlements/{id}/export-pdf` + ③ POST gf-accounting `/insurance-dossier-documents/acceptance-record/render-pdf` + ④ POST gf-accounting `/insurance-dossier-documents/payment-authorization/render-pdf`) → PARALLEL push N file qua ct-file-storage `/api/v1/files/upload-files` với `folderType="SETTLEMENTS"` → POST gf-accounting `/insurance-dossier-documents/batch` (persist atomic) → aggregate → FE | P2 (orchestrator) |
| 52 | `getInsuranceDossierVersions(settlementCode, page=0, size=10)` | `POST /api/v1/insurance-dossiers/search` body `{settlementCode, page, size}` (gf-accounting paginated list versions, Spring Pageable wrapper) | P1 |
| 53 | `recordInsurancePayment(code, input)` | `POST /api/v1/settlements/{code}/insurance-payments` | P1 |

### 3c.bis SDL types — Insurance Dossier (W02)

```graphql
# Input — formData ③ Biên bản nghiệm thu, thanh lý hợp đồng (Figma State 4 — 14 atomic fields, template-driven; +placeIssued 2026-06-26)
input QuoteReferenceInput {
  code: String                  # vd "BG-240426-01"
  date: String                  # dd/MM/yyyy
}
input AcceptanceCustomerInput {
  name: String!                 # Bên A — Họ tên / Tên đơn vị
  address: String!              # Bên A — Địa chỉ
}
input AcceptanceGarageInput {
  name: String!                 # Bên B — Tên đơn vị (Garage)
  delegate: String              # Bên B — Đại diện (nhập tay)
  delegateTitle: String         # Bên B — Chức vụ (nhập tay)
  address: String!              # Bên B — Địa chỉ
  taxId: String                 # Bên B — MST
  bankAccount: String           # Bên B — Số tài khoản
  bankName: String              # Bên B — Tên Ngân hàng
}
input AcceptanceFormInput {
  licensePlate: String!         # "Nhập biển kiểm soát xe"
  billDate: String!             # "Ngày lập biên bản" — dd/MM/yyyy
  placeIssued: String!          # "Địa điểm lập biên bản" — render câu mở "tại {placeIssued}" (added 2026-06-26)
  quoteReference: QuoteReferenceInput  # "Căn cứ phiếu báo giá"
  customer: AcceptanceCustomerInput!   # Bên A
  garage: AcceptanceGarageInput!       # Bên B
  clauses: [String!]!           # ClauseList ≥ 1
}

# Input — formData ④ Giấy ủy quyền nhận tiền bồi thường (Figma State 5 — 22 atomic fields, 4 sections)
input AuthorizationCustomerInput {
  name: String!                       # I.1 Họ tên / Tên đơn vị
  address: String!                    # I.2 Địa chỉ
  nationality: String                 # I.3 Quốc tịch
  delegate: String                    # I.4 Đại diện
  delegateTitle: String               # I.4 Chức vụ
  insuranceCertNo: String             # I.5 GCN bảo hiểm tự nguyện/bắt buộc
  nationalIdIssueDate: String         # I.6 Ngày cấp — dd/MM/yyyy
  nationalIdIssuer: String            # I.7 Nơi cấp
  nationalId: String                  # I.8 Số CMND / CCCD
}
input AuthorizationGarageInput {
  name: String!                       # II.1 Tên garage / Công ty
  taxId: String                       # II.2 Mã số thuế
  delegate: String                    # II.3 Đại diện
  delegateTitle: String               # II.4 Chức vụ (Figma "Chức vụ" — đồng nhất naming với Form 1)
  address: String                     # II.5 Địa chỉ garage (bổ sung 2026-06-26)
  phone: String                       # II.6 Số điện thoại garage (bổ sung 2026-06-26)
  bankAccount: String                 # II.7 Số tài khoản (tách riêng khỏi bankName, 2026-06-26)
  bankName: String                    # II.8 Tên ngân hàng (tách riêng, bổ sung 2026-06-26)
}
input AuthorizationVehicleInput {
  type: String!                       # III.1 Loại xe
  licensePlate: String!               # III.2 Biển kiểm soát
}
input AuthorizationCompensationInput {
  amountNumeric: Float!               # III.4 Số tiền bồi thường (decimal)
  amountInWords: String!              # III.5 Bằng chữ (FE/BE auto-convert TBD)
  content: String!                    # III.6 Nội dung
}
input AuthorizationFormInput {
  placeIssued: String!                # header "An Lão"
  dateIssued: String!                 # header date — dd/MM/yyyy
  customer: AuthorizationCustomerInput!   # I. Bên ủy quyền
  garage: AuthorizationGarageInput!       # II. Bên được ủy quyền
  vehicle: AuthorizationVehicleInput!     # III.1-2
  accidentDate: String!               # III.3 — dd/MM/yyyy
  compensation: AuthorizationCompensationInput!  # III.4-6
  commitmentClauses: [String!]!       # IV. Cam kết ≥ 3
}

# Enums
enum InsuranceDossierDocType {
  QUOTATION_SHEET             # ① Phiếu báo giá (cross-boundary gf-sales)
  SETTLEMENT_SHEET            # ② Phiếu quyết toán (local gf-accounting baseline)
  ACCEPTANCE_RECORD           # ③ Biên bản nghiệm thu (NEW Thymeleaf gf-accounting)
  PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION       # ④ Giấy ủy quyền nhận tiền bồi thường (NEW Thymeleaf gf-accounting)
}

enum DossierStatus {
  EXPORTED
  REPLACED
}

# Output — batch export response (4 URL ct-file-storage)
type DossierExportItem {
  documentType: InsuranceDossierDocType!
  fileUrl: String!            # public ct-file-storage URL — FE consume trực tiếp pattern hiện hữu
  fileName: String!           # tên file cố định theo docType
}

type DossierExportBatchResponse {
  versionNo: Int!             # auto-increment per settlementCode
  exports: [DossierExportItem!]!
}

# Output — list versions cho FEAT-INS-DOSSIER-VIEW (KHÔNG còn formData snapshot — form transient, BA chốt 2026-06-16)
type InsuranceDossierDocument {
  documentType: InsuranceDossierDocType!
  pdfUrl: String!
  pdfFileName: String!
  exportedAt: String!
}

type InsuranceDossierVersion {
  versionNo: Int!
  dossierStatus: DossierStatus!
  exportedAt: String!
  exportedBy: String!
  replacedByVersion: Int       # nullable — null nếu version mới nhất
  documents: [InsuranceDossierDocument!]!
}

type InsuranceDossierVersionsResponse {
  content: [InsuranceDossierVersion!]!   # ordered descending by versionNo
  page: Int!                              # current page (0-based)
  size: Int!                              # page size (max 50)
  totalElements: Int!                     # total versions cho settlementCode
  totalPages: Int!                        # ceil(totalElements / size)
}

# Schema declaration
type Mutation {
  exportInsuranceDossier(
    settlementCode: String!
    documentTypes: [InsuranceDossierDocType!]!
    acceptanceFormData: AcceptanceFormInput     # required khi ACCEPTANCE_RECORD ∈ documentTypes
    authorizationFormData: AuthorizationFormInput  # required khi PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION ∈ documentTypes
  ): DossierExportBatchResponse!
}

type Query {
  getInsuranceDossierVersions(
    settlementCode: String!
    page: Int = 0
    size: Int = 10            # max 50
  ): InsuranceDossierVersionsResponse!
}
```

### 3c.bis Behavior summary — Insurance Dossier ops

**`exportInsuranceDossier`** (mutation): **Orchestrator** — KHÔNG passthrough thuần. Gọi parallel các downstream render endpoint (gf-accounting + gf-sales), upload byte[] qua ct-file-storage, sau đó call persist endpoint gf-accounting. Chi tiết flow + implementation: xem [ADR-016 §Decision](../decisions/ADR-016-insurance-dossier-pdf-s3.md) + [PKG-W02 §2.2](../../Execution/work-packages/PKG-W02-insurance-dossier.md).

Downstream calls (theo thứ tự phase A→B→C→D):
- Phase A: `GET /api/v1/settlements/{settlementCode}` (gf-accounting) — resolve `serviceOrderId`.
- Phase B (parallel theo `documentTypes`): GET gf-sales `/api/v2/service-orders/{soId}/export-pdf?type=QUOTATION` (①) + GET gf-accounting `/api/v1/settlements/{id}/export-pdf` (②) + POST gf-accounting `/api/v1/insurance-dossier-documents/acceptance-record/render-pdf` (③) + POST gf-accounting `/api/v1/insurance-dossier-documents/payment-authorization/render-pdf` (④) — mỗi call trả byte[] PDF.
- Phase C (parallel): POST ct-file-storage `/api/v1/files/upload-files` multipart `files=<bytes>` + `folderType="SETTLEMENTS"` (× N) → N `{fileUrl, fileName}`. Reuse pattern multipart như op `uploadMultipleFiles`.
- Phase D: POST gf-accounting `/api/v1/insurance-dossier-documents/batch` body `{settlementCode, documents:[{documentType, fileUrl, fileName, formData?, isSelected}]}` → atomic persist `{dossierId, versionNo}`.

Input validation:
- `documentTypes.length >= 1` (BR-INS-DOSSIER-005).
- `acceptanceFormData != null` khi `ACCEPTANCE_RECORD ∈ documentTypes` — typed nested object (14 fields strict Figma State 4 — gồm `placeIssued`); BFF passthrough KHÔNG transform shape.
- `authorizationFormData != null` khi `PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION ∈ documentTypes` — typed nested object (22 fields strict Figma State 5, 4 sections); BFF passthrough KHÔNG transform shape.
- formData chỉ tồn tại trong request lifecycle — KHÔNG persist DB downstream (gf-accounting chỉ render PDF + lưu URL).

Error codes (`extensions.code` mapping):
- `INS_STL_NOT_FOUND` (404) — Phase A: settlement không tồn tại / khác tenant.
- `INS_DOSSIER_RENDER_FAIL` (502) — Phase B: render fail. Field `documentType` chỉ doc lỗi.
- `INS_DOSSIER_STORAGE_UPLOAD_FAIL` (502) — Phase C: ct-file-storage upload fail.
- `INS_DOSSIER_PERSIST_FAIL` (500) — Phase D: persist transaction rollback.
- `INS_DOSSIER_NO_DOC_SELECTED` (400) — input validation.
- `INS_DOSSIER_FORM_INCOMPLETE` (400) — input validation thiếu formData required.

**`getInsuranceDossierVersions`** (query): passthrough thuần **`POST /api/v1/insurance-dossiers/search`** (gf-accounting) với body `{settlementCode, page, size}`. Map response 1-1 (Spring Pageable wrapper: `content[], page, size, totalElements, totalPages`). KHÔNG cache. Default `page=0, size=10`, validation `size ∈ [1, 50]`.

Header propagation (cả 2 op): `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Branch-Id`, `x-request-id` forward downstream.

FE consume `fileUrl` theo pattern hiện hữu (anchor `download` / `window.open`). KHÔNG có wrapper "get file by docId" ở BFF.

> **Tái dùng / W01**: tạo Phiếu QT BH dùng `createInsuranceSettlement` (#44 — **op MỚI W01, CHƯA có trong source**); ghi 5 khoản điều chỉnh BH trên SO = **additive input trên `updateServiceOrderV3` (#119)**; chi tiết dùng `getSettlementByCode` (#39, response bổ sung block insurance). 5 op insurance (#49–53) khai báo trong module `gf-accounting/insurance-dossiers` + `gf-sales/service-orders` (moduleLoader: mỗi module export `typeDefs` + `resolvers` từ `index.ts`).

## 4. Forbidden Patterns

- Không issue JWT hoặc persist session trong gateway nếu downstream IAM/tenant service mới là authority.
- Không thêm persistence layer mới cho BFF nếu chưa có ADR rõ ràng.
- Không gọi direct database của downstream service trong resolver.
- Không log raw `Authorization`, token, file content hoặc PII payload.
- Không đổi tên public operation nếu chưa có deprecation/migration plan.

## 3d. Inventory Catalog V2 (`inventory-catalog` module — ADR-017/018, IMPLEMENTED W03)

> Module: `src/graphql/modules/gf-inventory/catalog-v2/` (`catalog-v2.schema.ts` + `catalog-v2.resolver.ts` + `catalog-v2.types.ts` + `catalog-v2.service.ts` + `catalog-v2.enrichment.ts` + `error-code-map.ts` + `export-proxy.ts`) — đã build trong W03, KHÔNG còn là design proposal. **R39 fix (2026-07-02)** — path trước đó ghi sai `src/graphql/modules/inventory-catalog/`; path thật nằm dưới `gf-inventory/` (nested cùng các module gf-inventory khác), tên file dùng suffix `catalog-v2` (không phải `inventory-catalog`); "Module" column trong §2/§3d.2/§3d.5 đồng bộ theo convention nested-path đã dùng cho các module khác (vd `gf-accounting/settlements`) → đổi thành `gf-inventory/catalog-v2`. Passthrough nguyên tắc (per HLD §3 "Stateless gateway, KHÔNG own DB"); KHÔNG persistence / KHÔNG business logic ở BFF. Forward header `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Branch-Id`. **AP slice (kỳ kế toán) deferred to gf-accounting wave** per Delivery Authority boundary correction 2026-06-23 (R4 strip). 23 operations này cũng được liệt kê trong §2 Endpoint Summary (module `gf-inventory/catalog-v2`).

  # R41 (2026-07-03) — diff-by-id collections mirror InternalProductUpdateRequest DTO backend

# R30 — ImportRow.item KHÔNG thể reuse input type ImportInternalProductItem làm output

# (KHÔNG phải `ImportInternalProductItemOutput`; R30/R32 pass trước đặt tên khác code).
type ImportInternalProductItemEcho {
  code: String
  name: String
  mainUnitCode: String
  nature: ProductNature
  materialGroupCode: String
  brand: String
  originCode: String
  productSpec: String
  technicalSpec: String
}

type ImportRow { rowIndex: Int! item: ImportInternalProductItemEcho errors: [String!]! }
# R39 fix — `item` nullable (code KHÔNG có outer `!`); toàn bộ field trong ImportInternalProductItemEcho
# cũng nullable ở code thật (KHÔNG mirror `!` markers của input ImportInternalProductItem).

type ImportInternalProductsResult {
  importId: String!
  importedCount: Int!
  failedCount: Int!
  report: ImportInternalProductsReport!
}

### 3d.3 Resolver discipline

- **Passthrough only** — mỗi resolver = `PassthroughService` call REST gf-inventory (hoặc gf-erp-mdm cho UoM). KHÔNG persistence trong BFF.
- **Enrichment** pattern (BR-AGG-GARAGE-GRAPH-001):
  - `InternalProduct.mainUnitDisplayName` — batch enrich từ `getInternalProduct`/`searchInternalProducts` response: gom tất cả `mainUnitCode` distinct → batch query gf-erp-mdm catalog `directory=UNIT` → map (R8 D-A/E rename UoM → Unit).
  - `InternalProduct.originDisplayName` (R18 new) — gom `originCode` distinct → batch query gf-erp-mdm catalog `directory=COUNTRY` → map. Shared client + cache (5min) với UNIT lookups. (Pattern thay thế cho `brandDisplayName` đã xóa post-R18.)
  - `InternalProduct.materialGroupName` — resolver gọi V2-3 batch (hoặc include trong V2-7 backend response — backend decide).
  - `InternalProductConversionUnit.unitDisplayName` — cùng pattern Unit (R8 D-E rename).
  - `InternalProductSkuMapping.sku/productName` — đã có trong V2-23 search response; cho V2-8 detail backend `GET /api/v2/internal-products/{id}` trả full mapping kèm sku/name.
  - `MaterialGroup.createdByName` + `MaterialGroup.updatedByName` (R20 NEW — Mobile detail Figma `21254:51661`) — **Pattern TENANT-USERS** (§3b prelude line ~40355, canonical pattern Receipt/Service/Delivery/Settlement/PurchaseOrder): sau khi BFF nhận response gf-inventory V2-3 / V2-1, gom distinct `*By` field values → gọi `ct-saas-tenant POST /api/v1/saas-tenant/tenant-users/search/basic` với body `{iamUserIds, tenantId}` (tenantId extract từ JWT); response `data.content[].{iamUserId, fullName}`; merge qua helper `enrichObjectWithByNames` (V2-Q3 single) hoặc `enrichArrayWithByNames` (V2-Q1 paged content[]). Conditional: chỉ gọi khi `*By` fields tồn tại VÀ `tenantId` từ JWT hợp lệ. Trả `null` khi `ct-saas-tenant` không match `iamUserId`.
  - `MaterialGroup.parentName` (R21 NEW — schema gap close, doc đã có ở "Flat-grouped-by-parent" bullet bên dưới nhưng SDL thiếu khai báo trước v7.24) — **backend-native enrichment, KHÔNG phải BFF batch**. gf-inventory backend tự resolve `parentName` qua recursive CTE trên `material_group` parent chain ngay trong response payload V2-1 (`POST /api/v2/material-groups/search`) và V2-3 (`GET /api/v2/material-groups/{id}`). BFF chỉ passthrough field từ REST → GraphQL — không gom IDs, không gọi REST riêng. Áp dụng tự động cho V2-Q1 paged `content[]` + V2-Q3 single + V2-Q2 tree (qua `MaterialGroupTreeNode.group`) + V2-M1/M2 mutation response. Trả `null` khi node là root (`parentId == null`). Contrast: KHÔNG dùng Pattern TENANT-USERS / CATALOG-FIND (vì không phải cross-boundary lookup).
  - **`listUnits` (V2-Q9, R39 ADD — bullet thiếu hoàn toàn dù resolver đã có sẵn)** — KHÔNG phải per-code enrichment mà là full-directory listing: resolver gọi thẳng `fetchAllUnits()` (`catalog-v2.enrichment.ts`) → `POST /api/v1/catalog/inquiry` với `{directory: "UNIT", size: 1000}` (không truyền `codes`) → map toàn bộ `content[]` thành `[Unit!]`. Side-effect: refresh in-process cache (5min TTL, key `UNIT::{tenantId}`) nên các lần `mainUnitDisplayName`/`conversionUnits[].unitDisplayName` enrichment kế tiếp trong cùng tenant có thể hit cache thay vì gọi lại gf-erp-mdm.
- **Row cap 500** — `verifyImportInternalProducts`/`importInternalProducts` resolver check `input.items.length ≤ 500` trước call REST; vượt → throw GraphQL error **`ERR-INV-041`** (R28 canonical 2026-06-25 sync Product `ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY v14 line 139` + `BR-CAT-PROD-020`; drop `ERR-INV-019` legacy) ngay tại BFF (defense-in-depth với BE). Backend trả `ERR-INV-044` cho originCode invalid trong import (per-row validation) — BFF pass-through.
- **Precision pass-through — `addConversionUnit`/`updateConversionUnit` (V2-M9/M10, R29 BA 2026-06-26)** — BFF KHÔNG validate scale `conversionRate` ở resolver layer (Float scalar không tự enforce precision). Backend gf-inventory app-layer guard ≤6 chữ số thập phân (BR-CAT-PROD-011 v15) — vượt → `400 ERR-INV-047`. BFF pass-through `extensions.code=ERR-INV-047` để FE render `INLINE_FIELD` per `ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY v16 line 145`. Lý do KHÔNG validate ở BFF: (a) Float scalar JS double-precision đủ cho 6-decimal typical values (4/12/24/0.5/0.333333); (b) tránh double validation drift; (c) backend là single source of truth cho domain rule. SDL `ConversionUnitInput.conversionRate: Float!` giữ nguyên (KHÔNG đổi sang Decimal scalar — breaking change không cần thiết).
- **Export pattern — `exportInternalProducts` (V2-Q7, R22 single-call BFF reverse-proxy)**: GraphQL Query KHÔNG stream binary trực tiếp (Apollo Server trả JSON). Resolver flow:
  (1) validate input filter (subset V2-Q4);
  (2) sinh **short-lived signed token** (TTL 60s) lưu in-memory/Redis với mapping `{token → {filter, tenantId từ JWT, userId}}`;
  (3) return `data.downloadUrl = "/export/internal-products/{token}"` (path BFF-internal).
  Khi FE GET URL: middleware BFF reverse-proxy validate token → re-construct request → call gf-inventory V2-22 với forwarded auth headers → stream binary response back to FE với `Content-Disposition: attachment` pass-through từ backend (filename `danh-muc-ma-san-pham-noi-bo-{timestamp}.xlsx`). Token expire sau 60s hoặc sau use-once.
  **KHÔNG dùng presigned S3 URL** (canonical Option A — async/presigned deferred future expansion CR).
  **KHÔNG paginated client-side assemble** (drop legacy pattern PKG-W03 §2.2.3 pre-R16).
  Defense-in-depth: backend hard-cap 1000 rows; BFF KHÔNG dry-run query (rely on backend reject — implementation cost cao).
  DEV note: verify precedent BFF reverse-proxy signed-token pattern ở `exportSettlementToPdf` (settlement module) hoặc tương tự khi DEV.
- **Tree size cap — `getMaterialGroupTree` (V2-Q2)** — MAX 1000 nodes per tenant. Vượt → resolver throw `ApiClientError` code **`MATERIAL_GROUP_TREE_OVERSIZE`** (**R39 fix** — code thật KHÔNG có prefix `GMS.agg-garage-graph.`; chuỗi đó không xuất hiện ở đâu trong codebase) HTTP 413, `details.hint: "redirect-to-paginated"` + message `"Tenant có {N} nhóm vật tư hàng hóa (>1000) — sử dụng paginated search V2-Q1 (searchMaterialGroups) thay thế."`. Vì lỗi được catch trong resolver try/catch (`createResolvers` wrapper), nó KHÔNG xuất hiện ở top-level GraphQL `errors[]` — mà resolve vào union `MaterialGroupTreeListResponse` dưới nhánh `ErrorResponse` (`__typename: "ErrorResponse"`, cùng field `code/message/statusCode/details`). BFF-enforce (defense-in-depth với backend V2-2 `ERR-INV-027`).
- **Flat-grouped-by-parent — `searchMaterialGroups` (V2-Q1, R7)** — Backend authoritative cho `ORDER BY (parent_path, display_order, id)` khi `input.sort=="default"` (or omitted) — siblings của cùng parent xếp adjacent across pages. BFF passthrough; `parentName` per row do backend tự fill trong V2-1 response (xem enrichment bullet `MaterialGroup.parentName` ở trên — recursive CTE, no separate REST call). FE render parent header (duplicate khi group spans pages — acceptable UX). Sort override `name,asc|desc`/`createdAt,desc` skip group ordering.
- **Error union** — tuân `Union resolver (data | ErrorResponse)` pattern (HLD §3 row 5); pass thẳng `ERR-INV-NNN` codes từ backend.

#### Query `searchMaterialGroups`

Module: `gf-inventory/catalog-v2`. Return type: `PagedMaterialGroupResponse!`.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent; gateway forward `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Branch-Id` xuống gf-inventory.
**Idempotency**: Read-only, không yêu cầu `Idempotency-Key`.

**Request** (**R39 note** — `parentIdProvided` thiếu trong biến ví dụ trước đó dù có trong SDL; ví dụ dưới lấy tất cả level nên omit `parentId`/`parentIdProvided`, xem alt-variant bên dưới cho trường hợp filter root-only):
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260701-0001"
  },
  "operationName": "searchMaterialGroups",
  "query": "query searchMaterialGroups($input: MaterialGroupSearchInput!) { searchMaterialGroups(input: $input) { __typename ... on PagedMaterialGroupApiResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename content { __typename id code name parentId parentName status description childrenCount productCount createdAt createdBy createdByName updatedAt updatedBy updatedByName } pageInfo { __typename page size totalElements totalPages first last hasNext hasPrevious } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "keyword": "Lốp",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "page": 0,
      "size": 20,
      "sort": "default"
    }
  }
}
```

    "parentIdProvided": true,
    "status": "ACTIVE",
    "page": 0,
    "size": 20
  }
}
```

**Diff scenarios mẫu** (mỗi field độc lập):
- `initialProducts: null` (omit) → giữ nguyên toàn bộ SKU mappings hiện có.
- `initialProducts: []` → xoá hết SKU mappings.
- `initialConversionUnits: [{ id: 7001, unitCode: "BOX", conversionRate: 15 }]` → update rate row `id=7001` (nếu gửi `unitCode` khác giá trị lưu trong DB → backend từ chối per BR-CAT-PROD-011, `unitCode` immutable khi có id); các row khác **bị xoá** vì không có trong list.
- `attachments: [{ fileUrl, fileName, fileType, fileSizeBytes }]` (không có id) → xoá hết row hiện có + insert 1 row mới.

#### Query `exportInternalProducts`

Module: `gf-inventory/catalog-v2`. Return type: `InternalProductExportFileUrlResponse!` (R33 rename từ `ExportFileUrlResponse` — trùng tên với union cùng tên ở `gf-sales/service-orders`/`gf-accounting/settlements`, gây `__resolveType` bị module merge sau ghi đè, phát hiện qua live API test 2026-07-01) (union `ApiResponseExportFileUrlPayload | ErrorResponse`; `data: ExportFileUrlPayload { downloadUrl: String! }`).

> **Đặc biệt — NOT plain passthrough.** Per §3d.3 "Export pattern" (R22 canonical Option A single-call BFF reverse-proxy): resolver validate filter → sinh short-lived signed token (TTL 60s, in-memory/Redis, use-once) → return `data.downloadUrl = "/export/internal-products/{token}"` (BFF-internal path). FE gọi Q7 1 lần → nhận URL → `window.location.href = url` hoặc `<a download href={url}>` → browser GET → middleware BFF validate token → reverse-proxy stream binary từ V2-22 với `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="danh-muc-ma-san-pham-noi-bo-{timestamp}.xlsx"` pass-through. **KHÔNG presigned S3, KHÔNG paginated client-side assemble, KHÔNG binary trong GraphQL response.**

**Transport**: `POST /graphql` (GraphQL query trả URL); binary stream tách qua BFF middleware endpoint.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent. Token stored server-side kèm `tenantId + userId` từ JWT để middleware re-authorize khi FE GET URL.
**Idempotency**: Read-only.

**Request** (filter subset V2-Q4 — omit `page/size/sort`, per §3d.2 V2-Q7 note):
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260701-0021"
  },
  "operationName": "exportInternalProducts",
  "query": "query exportInternalProducts($filter: InternalProductSearchInput) { exportInternalProducts(filter: $filter) { __typename ... on ApiResponseExportFileUrlPayload { __typename success code message data { __typename downloadUrl } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "filter": {
      "keyword": "Lốp",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "nature": "GOODS",
      "materialGroupId": 123
    }
  }
}
```

**Response 200** (BFF-generated signed token URL, TTL 60s — NOT S3 presigned, NOT direct binary):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "exportInternalProducts": {
      "__typename": "ApiResponseExportFileUrlPayload",
      "success": true,
      "code": "OK",
      "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "ExportFileUrlPayload",
        "downloadUrl": "/export/internal-products/eyJ0IjoidGVuYW50LTEzMyIsImV4cCI6MTcxOTgxNjMwMH0.k3aBc7QpXm2..."
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error codes** (row-cap `ERR-INV-045` KHÔNG surface tại GraphQL layer — surface downstream khi FE GET `downloadUrl` từ middleware; middleware then trả HTTP 400 body `{"error": {"code": "ERR-INV-045", ...}}` từ backend V2-22 để FE render DIALOG per `ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY v14 line 143`):
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth (kể cả token signing). |
| `ERR-CMN-validation` | 400 | Filter shape sai (vd `nature` invalid enum). |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward (nếu resolver validate step gọi backend prefetch — thường KHÔNG). |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Token generation/signing failure. |

**Middleware layer — errors phát sinh sau khi FE GET `downloadUrl`** (KHÔNG hiển thị tại GraphQL response — FE handle riêng qua HTTP response từ middleware):

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `ERR-INV-045` | 400 | **Row cap > 1000** — backend V2-22 reject; middleware forward body cho FE. FE render **DIALOG** "Kết quả vượt 1.000 dòng — vui lòng áp dụng bộ lọc để thu hẹp phạm vi rồi xuất lại" (per BR-CAT-PROD-024 + FEAT-CAT-PROD-EXPORT AC-5 + `ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY v14 line 143`). |
| `ERR-CMN-token-expired` | 401 | Token > 60s TTL hoặc use-twice attempt — middleware reject, FE prompt user gọi lại Q7. |
| `ERR-CMN-token-invalid` | 401 | Token signature/format sai — middleware reject. |
| Standard forward errors | downstream | 5xx từ backend V2-22 khi generate .xlsx (Apache POI). |

## 3e. Accounting Period (`gf-accounting` module — DESIGN, ADR-019)

> ⚠️ Thiết kế cho 5 features `FEAT-AP-LIST/CREATE/DETAIL/EDIT/DELETE` (EP-INVENTORY-ACCOUNTING-PERIOD). Boundary correction Delivery Authority 2026-06-23 — AP master moved từ gf-inventory sang `gf-accounting`; CLAUDE override 2026-06-24 bind authoritative; BA frontmatter Product files vẫn ghi `boundary: gf-inventory` (chưa fix — OQ1). 7 operations passthrough sang `gf-accounting` `/api/v2/accounting-periods/*` + `/protected/v1/accounting-periods/lock-check`. Web GMS only (mobile out of scope per UX-FLOW-INVENTORY-ACCOUNTING-PERIOD line 31).
>
> Resolver discipline same as catalog-v2: passthrough only, no business logic, error union, tree cap defensive, lock-check cache.

### 3e.3 Resolver discipline

- **Passthrough only** — không persistence, không business logic; SDL field shape khớp REST response shape (camelCase consistent).
- **Enrichment pattern (2 sources)** — (a) `parentName` + `parentBreadcrumb` ở `AccountingPeriod`/`AccountingPeriodDetail` enrich **từ backend response** (gf-accounting tự include qua recursive CTE — không separate REST call). Nếu backend trả thiếu, resolver trả NULL (defensive — không fan-out request thêm vào gf-accounting để tránh N+1). (b) `createdByName`/`updatedByName` trên **`AccountingPeriod` flat (AP-M1 `createdPeriod` + AP-M2 return single qua `enrichObjectWithByNames`)** + **`AccountingPeriodDetail` (AP-Q3 single qua `enrichObjectWithByNames`)** (v7.51 add, v7.52 corrected, v7.53 extend broad scope, v7.54 narrow sau khi AP-Q1 removed — chỉ single-object use-case, không còn paged `enrichArrayWithByNames` cho AP module) — **BFF-layer Pattern TENANT-USERS** (§3b prelude line ~43181, canonical Receipt/Service/Delivery/Settlement/PurchaseOrder/MaterialGroup): sau khi BFF nhận response gf-accounting §4.3/§4.4/§4.5, resolver gom distinct `createdBy`/`updatedBy` từ response single-object → gọi `ct-saas-tenant POST /api/v1/saas-tenant/tenant-users/search/basic` với body `{iamUserIds, tenantId}` (tenantId extract từ JWT); response `data.content[].{iamUserId, fullName}`; merge qua helper `enrichObjectWithByNames`. Conditional: chỉ gọi khi `*By` fields tồn tại VÀ JWT có `tenantId` hợp lệ. Trả `null` khi `ct-saas-tenant` không match `iamUserId`. Batch efficient: 1 request map cả `createdBy` + `updatedBy` khi cả 2 present trong cùng row. **KHÔNG cần backend `gf-accounting-api.md §4.3..§4.5` add ByName fields** — enrichment BFF-only, backend giữ nguyên chỉ trả `createdBy`/`updatedBy` string.
- **Tree size cap — `searchAccountingPeriodTree` (AP-Q2)** — MAX 500 nodes per tenant. Vượt → throw GraphQL error `GMS.agg-garage-graph.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD_TREE_OVERSIZE` HTTP 413 với `hint: "Tenant có >500 kỳ kế toán — sử dụng filter năm (year) hoặc name LIKE cụ thể để narrow scope tree"` (v7.54 update hint sau khi AP-Q1 paged search removed — fallback trước đây trỏ AP-Q1 giờ không còn; AP-Q2 đã support `year` + `name` filter per §4.2). BFF-enforce (**R2 F2 fix**: backend trả plain HTTP 413 no registry error code; BFF-only code là single point cho user-facing tree-cap error — không reuse deprecated `ERR-INV-027` registry:125 HTTP 500 BR-PRC-007). Conform PL5 pattern (mirror catalog-v2 §3d.3 `getMaterialGroupTree` rule).
- **Name search normalization (R4 — AP-Q2)** — `input.name` (optional) → backend xử lý LIKE-unaccent (`WHERE LOWER(unaccent(name)) LIKE ...`) trên cột `accounting_period.name` qua existing index `idx_ap_tenant_name`. BFF passthrough only (KHÔNG normalize tại BFF; backend authoritative để dùng đúng index strategy + Vietnamese collation consistent với V2-24 flat search).
- **Lock-check cache — `checkAccountingPeriodLock` (AP-Q4)** — LRU cache 30s, key `(tenantId, date)`. Cache scope mandatory (defensive vs cross-tenant/cross-date leak per INTEG-EXT-gf-accounting §15 forbidden). Cache-bypass query option có thể thêm sau (`forceRefresh: Boolean` argument — defer cho future wave).
- **Error union** — tuân `Union resolver (data | ErrorResponse)` pattern (HLD §3 row 5); pass thẳng `ERR-INV-021..026` codes từ backend per ADR-019 D2 (keep verbatim, no rename) + `ERR-AP-001` (BR-AP-016 immutable-field per **R2 F1 fix** — NEW namespace `ERR-AP-*` dedicated cho Accounting Period domain on gf-accounting, switched từ `ERR-INV-032` đã collide với registry:130 BR-OB-008; pending BA register — OQ7). Tree-cap không pass-through từ backend — BFF-only code `GMS.agg-garage-graph.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD_TREE_OVERSIZE` (xem rule trên, R2 F2 fix).
- **Cross-boundary single hop** — AP operations chỉ touch gf-accounting (không cross-call gf-sales/gf-inventory); enrichment data đã embedded trong response.

AP ops KHÔNG cho mobile trong batch hiện tại (UX-FLOW-INVENTORY-ACCOUNTING-PERIOD line 31 "Garage Care (Web GMS) only"). Module mới không thêm vào mobile schema bundle. Future mobile expansion = CR riêng.

```json
{

    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260709-1001"

#### Mutation `deleteAccountingPeriod`

Module: `accounting-period`. Return type: `Boolean!`.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent.
**Idempotency**: Idempotent (delete same `id` twice → second returns 404 `ERR-CMN-not-found`).
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-accounting` | `DELETE` | `/api/v2/accounting-periods/{id}` | V4-AP-6 (`gf-accounting-api.md §4.6`) |

**Request** (3-guard delete per BR-AP-013/014: (1) `status=OPEN` + (2) no children + (3) no stock transactions; guard (3) delegated to downstream Receipt/Delivery/OB/PRC backends per §4.6 note — batch hiện tại enforce (1)+(2)):
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260707-1007"
  },
  "operationName": "deleteAccountingPeriod",
  "query": "mutation deleteAccountingPeriod($id: ID!) { deleteAccountingPeriod(id: $id) }",
  "variables": { "id": "1024" }
}
```

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "deleteAccountingPeriod": true
  }
}
```

**Error response shape** (guard 1 vi phạm — kỳ CLOSED không thể xóa; response envelope theo GraphQL `errors[]` pattern do return type `Boolean!` non-nullable không thể wrap `ErrorResponse` union):
```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "message": "Kỳ kế toán đã đóng hoặc đã phát sinh dữ liệu kho liên quan nên không được xóa.",
      "extensions": {
        "code": "ERR-INV-025",
        "statusCode": 400,
        "details": { "guardViolated": "STATUS_CLOSED", "periodStatus": "CLOSED" }
      }
    }
  ],
  "data": { "deleteAccountingPeriod": null }
}
```

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth. |
| `ERR-CMN-not-found` | 404 | `id` không tồn tại (idempotent second-call). |
| `ERR-INV-025` | 400 | Guard 1: `status=CLOSED` HOẶC Guard 3: có stock transactions liên quan (BR-AP-013 — guard 3 downstream-enforced per §4.6). |
| `ERR-INV-026` | 400 | Guard 2: có kỳ con (recursive CTE check on `parent_id` — BR-AP-014). |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward from gf-accounting. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback. |

## 3g. Opening Balance (`gf-inventory/opening-balance` module — DESIGN, W04, ADR-020/021/022)

> W04 addition — passthrough module cho 7 REST endpoints `gf-inventory /api/v2/opening-balances/*` (W04-1 + W04-3..W04-8 per `gf-inventory-api.md §3b` — W04-2 template removed 2026-07-06 per Q2 fix; W04-8 GET single line added 2026-07-10 per BUG-W04-016 BFF slice). Web GMS đầy đủ (list + verify + import + edit + get-detail + delete + delete-lines); App Garage view-only list (per UX-FLOW-INVENTORY-OPENING-BALANCE §29). Naming Registry canonical → `See gf-inventory-api.md §5.1 Opening Balance`.

### 3g.3 Resolver discipline

- **Pure passthrough + 2 enrichments** — no BFF business logic; resolver forwards JWT + `X-Tenant-Id` header to gf-inventory REST (`gfInventoryService.post/get/put/delete`). `productName`/`warehouseName`/`mainUnitCode` denormalized ở gf-inventory response (Data Ownership §5.5 of gf-inventory-HLD.md, snapshot at import). **`mainUnitName` enrichment** (v7.50 add per user request): resolver batch collect distinct `mainUnitCode` từ `content[]` → gọi `fetchAllUnits()` (`catalog-v2.enrichment.ts` — reuse module-shared cache TTL 5min, key `UNIT::{tenantId}`) → map `mainUnitCode` → `mainUnitName`. Fallback null nếu unit code không có trong gf-erp-mdm directory=UNIT (defensive — không throw, không fan-out per-row). Same enrichment pattern as catalog V2 `InternalProduct.mainUnitDisplayName` (§3d resolver line ~44967-44974) — 2 field khác tên nhưng chung mechanism + cache. **`createdByName` enrichment** (v7.53 add per user request "các api lấy chi tiết wave 04 đều cần trả thêm ByName"; v7.61 extend scope to W04-Q3 get-detail single per BUG-W04-016 BFF slice): resolver batch collect distinct `createdBy` từ `OpeningBalanceLine` response (W04-Q1 paged `content[]` qua `enrichArrayWithByNames`; W04-Q3 return single + W04-M3 return single qua `enrichObjectWithByNames`) → gọi **BFF-layer Pattern TENANT-USERS** `ct-saas-tenant POST /api/v1/saas-tenant/tenant-users/search/basic` với `{iamUserIds, tenantId từ JWT}` → map `createdBy` → `createdByName`. Conditional: chỉ gọi khi `createdBy` tồn tại VÀ JWT có `tenantId`. Fallback null khi ct-saas-tenant không match iamUserId. KHÔNG có `updatedByName` — SDL `OpeningBalanceLine` không track `updatedBy` (snapshot pattern). **2 batch call riêng**: mainUnitName qua gf-erp-mdm directory=UNIT (in-process cache TTL 5min shared với catalog V2), createdByName qua ct-saas-tenant tenant-users — không chung cache. Cùng canonical pattern §3b prelude line ~43181 (Receipt/Service/Delivery/Settlement/PurchaseOrder/MaterialGroup precedent).
- **Defense-in-depth 500 cap** (ADR-022): resolver validates `input.rows.length <= 500` **before** forwarding; violation → GraphQL `extensions.code=ERR-INV-048` per `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.3`. Same behavior as V2-20/V2-21 catalog import.
- **Canonical + display coexist migration (v7.56 add)** — `OpeningBalanceImportRow` shape carry both canonical identifiers (`mainUnitCode` + `warehouseId`) AND display fallback (`unitName` + `warehouseName`). Resolver passthrough all 4 xuống gf-inventory REST — backend authoritative validation: canonical wins khi provided (cross-check với display); fallback resolve display legacy path khi canonical missing. FE nên gửi cả 2 để đảm bảo deterministic + audit consistency. Migration semantic: sau khi FE 100% send canonical → separate CR deprecate `unitName`/`warehouseName` legacy inputs.
- **Idempotency-key forwarding**: W04-M2 argument `idempotencyKey` forwards as HTTP header `X-Idempotency-Key: {value}` — required (not optional in resolver — enforce match backend). Value format must match `OB-IMPORT-{tenantId}-{uuid}` (ADR-022).
- **No caching in BFF** — lock-check TTL cache lives in gf-inventory (ADR-021); BFF stays stateless per module discipline.
- **Naming Registry cross-tier**: Field names verbatim per `gf-inventory-api.md §5.1 Opening Balance` — no rename BFF-side (see §5.1 registry rule "1 concept ↔ 1 canonical name").
- **Error codes pass-through**: `ERR-INV-009/010/017/018/019/020/024/032/033/034/035/036/048` from gf-inventory REST → `extensions.code` on GraphQL error; `warningLockCheckUnavailable: true` on VerifyImportResult when downstream returns 502/503 for AP lock-check (ADR-021 fail-OPEN verify marker; FE disables commit button).

Mobile schema bundle KHÔNG include W04-Q3 (get-detail single line) or W04-M1..M5 (import/edit/delete) — web-only. Template `.xlsx` cũng web-only (FE bundled asset, không có GraphQL op). Mobile hub `FEAT-INV-MOBILE-MENU` tile "Tồn đầu kỳ" → tap → mobile route wired to `searchOpeningBalances` only.

| `ERR-CMN-not-found` | 404 | `id` không tồn tại **trong tenant** — return "Dòng OB không tồn tại". Cross-tenant id cũng trả 404 (không leak sự tồn tại — BR-OB-CMN-002; per `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.2 W04-8` Response 4xx). |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward from gf-inventory (backpressure, DB timeout). |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback. |

      ]

}

**Response 200** (backend passthrough W04-3; `previewLines[]` marks each row VALID or ERROR với error codes per BR-OB-005..016; `canCommit=false` khi bất kỳ error row nào tồn tại theo BR-OB-004a all-or-nothing; `warningLockCheckUnavailable=true` khi gf-accounting lock-check returned 502/503 per ADR-021 fail-OPEN verify marker — FE disables commit button):

            ]
          }
        ],
        "canCommit": false,

      }
    }
  }

**Error response shape**: identical union `ErrorResponse`.

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch. |
| `ERR-INV-048` | 400 | `input.rows.length > 500` or `input.rows` empty — **BFF defensive throws BEFORE forward** (per §3g.3 + ADR-018/022 3-layer defense); backend also throws same code (BR-OB-004b). |
| `ERR-CMN-validation` | 400 | `fileChecksum` malformed (non-SHA-256), `rows[].asOfDate` malformed (not `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `ERR-INV-009` / `ERR-INV-010` / `ERR-INV-017` / `ERR-INV-018` / `ERR-INV-019` / `ERR-INV-020` / `ERR-INV-024` / `ERR-INV-032` / `ERR-INV-033` / `ERR-INV-034` / `ERR-INV-035` / `ERR-INV-036` | 400 (per-row) | Row-level validation errors surface inside `previewLines[].errors[]` — response body is `200 OK`; these codes appear only if BE returns them at top-level (fatal file-level, rare). Per-code semantics = `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.3`. |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward. gf-accounting lock-check 502/503 → surface as `warningLockCheckUnavailable: true` in data payload, NOT as GraphQL error (ADR-021 fail-OPEN verify marker). |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback. |

#### Mutation `importOpeningBalances`

Module: `opening-balance`. Return type: `ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse!`.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated/context-dependent.
**Idempotency**: **Idempotent via required `idempotencyKey` argument** (format `OB-IMPORT-{tenantId}-{uuid}` per ADR-022). Argument forwarded as HTTP header `X-Idempotency-Key: {value}` to downstream; downstream dedup 24h via `processed_events` per `gf-inventory-HLD.md §5`. BFF defense-in-depth: rejects `input.rows.length > 500` với `ERR-INV-048`.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/opening-balances/import` (with header `X-Idempotency-Key`) | W04-4 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3b.2`) |

**Request** (client re-submits same shape as `verifyImportOpeningBalances` after preview `canCommit=true`; server-side re-validates authoritative + re-runs lock-check per ADR-021 authoritative commit-time; single `@Transactional` all-or-nothing commit; cascade sổ tồn atomic via `StockLedgerRecomputeService` per ADR-020):
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "x-request-id": "req-20260707-0004"
  },
  "operationName": "importOpeningBalances",
  "query": "mutation importOpeningBalances($input: VerifyImportOpeningBalancesInput!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { importOpeningBalances(input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename totalRows importedRows importedAt importedBy fileName fileChecksum alreadyImported cascadedKeys { __typename productCode warehouseCode fromDate recomputedRows } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "fileName": "OB-2026-Q1.xlsx",
      "fileChecksum": "sha256:abc123def456",
      "rows": [
        {
          "rowNumber": 2,
          "productCode": "SP-NB-000123",
          "productName": "Lốp xe 175/70R13",
          "unitName": "Cái",
          "mainUnitCode": "UNIT_CAI",
          "warehouseName": "Kho tổng",
          "warehouseId": 12,
          "quantity": 240,
          "value": 12000000,
          "asOfDate": "2026-01-01"
        }
      ]
    },
    "idempotencyKey": "OB-IMPORT-1001-b3d2e7a1-4f8c-4a2f-8e6b-2c9a1d5e7f0a"
  }
}
```

**Response 200** (backend passthrough W04-4; `importedRows == totalRows` per BR-OB-004a all-or-nothing; `cascadedKeys[]` reports each distinct `(productCode, warehouseCode)` touched với number of ledger rows recomputed forward per ADR-020; `alreadyImported=true` when idempotency-key replay hits dedup cache):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "importOpeningBalances": {
      "__typename": "ImportOpeningBalancesResultApiResponse",
      "success": true,
      "code": "OK",
      "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "ImportOpeningBalancesResult",
        "totalRows": 1,
        "importedRows": 1,
        "importedAt": "2026-07-07T09:45:12Z",
        "importedBy": "operator@garage.com",
        "fileName": "OB-2026-Q1.xlsx",
        "fileChecksum": "sha256:abc123def456",
        "alreadyImported": false,
        "cascadedKeys": [
          {
            "__typename": "StockLedgerCascadeAudit",
            "productCode": "SP-NB-000123",
            "warehouseCode": "WH-01",
            "fromDate": "2026-01-01",
            "recomputedRows": 8
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**: identical union `ErrorResponse`.

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED` / `GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED` / `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Standard gateway; missing required `idempotencyKey` arg → `BAD_USER_INPUT`. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch. |
| `ERR-INV-048` | 400 | `input.rows.length > 500` — BFF defensive throws (per §3g.3). |
| `ERR-CMN-validation` | 400 | `idempotencyKey` malformed (not matching `OB-IMPORT-{tenantId}-{uuid}` pattern). |
| `ERR-INV-034` | 400 | Trùng OB (mã+kho) — either dedup-in-file or vs existing DB row (BR-OB-012); all-or-nothing rollback (per `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.3`). |
| `ERR-INV-024` | 400 | Any row's `asOfDate` falls in CLOSED accounting period (authoritative re-check at commit per ADR-021); all-or-nothing rollback. |
| `ERR-INV-035` | 400 | OB `asOfDate` ≥ existing slip date for (mã+kho) — OB must precede slips (BR-OB-016). |
| `ERR-INV-036` | 400 | Cascade recompute làm `closing_qty < 0` tại some day — invariant violation per BR-STKV2-005a step 4 (ADR-020); transaction rollback. |
| `ERR-INV-009` / `ERR-INV-010` / `ERR-INV-017` / `ERR-INV-018` / `ERR-INV-019` / `ERR-INV-020` / `ERR-INV-032` / `ERR-INV-033` | 400 | Row-level validation (product not found, inactive, missing field, malformed date, unit mismatch, warehouse not found, qty ≤ 0, value < 0). Response shape includes `errorRows[]` list (same shape as verify preview). |
| `409` (conflict) | 409 | `X-Idempotency-Key` dedup 24h hit — returns previous response with `alreadyImported: true` inside 200 body, NOT 409 (per W04-4 semantics `gf-inventory-api.md §3b.2`). |
| `503` | 503 | gf-accounting lock-check unreachable → **fail-CLOSED per ADR-021** commit path → surfaces as `HTTP_ERROR 503 ERR-CMN-007` ("Hệ thống đang bận, vui lòng thử lại sau" — platform-wide toast, đã đăng ký `Product/error-code/ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY.md:71`). |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `HTTP_ERROR` / `API_ERROR` | downstream | Forward. |
| `UNKNOWN_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Fallback (e.g. Redisson lock timeout in recompute). |
