### 3i.3 Resolver discipline

Same discipline as §3h.3 (receipt-v2 module) — mirror symmetric. **HRMS staff DataLoader enrichment** for `stockKeeperName` on `DeliveryV2` list content items + `DeliveryV2Detail` single-fetch — same pattern as §3h.3 v7.65 S3e bullet (batch `POST /api/v1/employees/lookup-by-iam` for list, single-fetch `GET /api/v1/employees/by-iam/{iamUserId}` for detail, Redis 5min cache scope `(tenantId, iamUserId)`, fail-OPEN → `stockKeeperName: null` per ADR-025 + BR-IDV2-021 v25 + `INTEG-BFF-agg-garage-graph-gf-hrms.md v1`). Additional Delivery-specific bullets:

- **SO Reconciliation `reconciliationWarnings[]` passthrough — v7.72 narrow (ARCH-REVIEW-W05 A8 P1 + ADR-024 D2 v6 + D5 v6 + BR-IDV2-009 v39 chốt 2026-07-16)**: backend `gf-inventory` populates `reconciliationWarnings[]` field **CHỈ tại W05-D5 postDeliveryV2 response** — NEVER at W05-D3 createDeliveryV2 hoặc W05-D4 updateDeliveryV2 (những mutation này luôn trả `reconciliationWarnings: []` bất kể `postOnSave`/edit path — reconciliation là **post-only** per state transition Nháp→Ghi sổ). BFF resolver passes through the array as-is — NO compare logic at BFF (backend authoritative per ADR-024 A4 rejected). Warning shape: `[{code, message, lineIndex?, productCode?, warehouseCode?, expectedFromSo?, actualFromDelivery?}]`. Endpoint downstream: backend `gf-inventory` gọi `gf-sales GET /protected/v1/service-orders/{tenantId}/detail/{code}` (v7.72 endpoint direction fix cite ADR-024 v5 + INTEG-EXT-gf-inventory v15/v17; bản cũ `/product/so-summary` sai direction removed). **2-step user-confirm commit** (ADR-024 D5 v6): (i) `overrideWarnings=false` (default) — probe: case C2 clean → 200 empty warnings; case C3 warning → 409 `ERR-INV-039-RECONCILIATION-WARNING` + warnings[] payload NO commit; case C4 gf-sales unreachable → 409 `ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED` NO commit; (ii) `overrideWarnings=true` — commit override: SKIP gf-sales entirely + commit direct (case C5). **BFF `overrideWarnings` passthrough**: forward param từ input variable → REST body verbatim; NO orchestration (BFF KHÔNG tự sinh 2 REST call từ 1 GraphQL mutation call). **Client Web + Mobile FE responsibility**: sinh 2 GraphQL mutation call — 1 probe (`overrideWarnings=false`), 1 commit (`overrideWarnings=true`) sau user Xác nhận "Vẫn Ghi sổ" trên warning popup. New idempotencyKey giữa 2 call (không reuse — response khác nhau). Client (FE) renders popup [Đóng] / [Vẫn Ghi sổ] per BR-IDV2-009 v39 wording ("Đối soát đơn dịch vụ có sai lệch — bạn có muốn tiếp tục Ghi sổ?" cho warning case; "Không thể đối soát với đơn dịch vụ — bạn có muốn tiếp tục Ghi sổ?" cho DEGRADED case). No BFF cache for reconciliation (backend Caffeine 60s cache scope `(tenantId, serviceOrderCode)` per ADR-024 D2 — BFF stays stateless).
- **Cost/price semantic Delivery-specific** (differs from Receipt): `DeliveryV2Line.unitPrice` là **giá bán** (không phải cost). `DeliveryV2Line.costUnitPrice` là PWA **giá vốn** — nullable, populated by future PWA engine M3 waves (không W05 scope); default `0` tại create/edit per ADR-023 D6. `cascadeSummary.cascadedKeys[].closingValueDelta` cho POST Delivery operate với cost=0 giá trị (ledger value change = 0 tại W05; sẽ retrospectively update sau PWA).
- **Cross-slip inheritance READ passthrough** (W05-D10 + W05-D11): symmetric với R10/R11 — pure passthrough, no compare logic at BFF. Backend `gf-inventory` computes suggested lines + validate SL vượt gốc server-side per ADR-024 D1.
- **Naming Registry cross-tier**: Field names verbatim per `gf-inventory-api.md §5.4 (Receipt + Delivery V2)` — no rename BFF-side. Same `SlipCascadeSummary` + `SlipCascadeKey` + `AttachmentKind` + `AttachmentFileType` shared types imported from §3h.1.
- **Error codes pass-through**: Additional Delivery-specific — `ERR-INV-039` (SO product/quantity mismatch — surfaces in `reconciliationWarnings[].code` NOT in top-level ErrorResponse — warning-only per BR-IDV2-009). Other codes: `ERR-INV-024/032/033/034/036/037/038/040/041/042/CONFLICT` + `ERR-CMN-004/005/007/validation/not-found` from gf-inventory REST → `extensions.code` on GraphQL error.
- **`skuName` render-time derivation** (v7.68 S3h per REST `gf-inventory-api.md v55 S3l` W05-D3 Semantics bullet — symmetric with §3h.3 receipt): BFF resolver at read time derives `DeliveryV2Line.skuName` via BE LEFT JOIN legacy `product` by `line.sku` (Vendor SKU registry — legacy `product` table trong catalog-legacy scope). DataLoader batch by `sku` recommended (dedup + cap 100, mirror HRMS DataLoader pattern §3h.3 cho `stockKeeperName`). NULL nếu `sku IS NULL` OR legacy `product` không match (SKU deleted / renamed / no legacy entry). **Client MUST NOT send `skuName` in any input types** (`CreateDeliveryV2LineInput` / `UpdateDeliveryV2LineInput`) — server-only field mirror `mainUnitCode` (v7.66 S3f) enforcement pattern. Fail-OPEN degradation: legacy `product` table unreachable → `skuName: null` cho tất cả rows (SKU code still returned từ `sku` snapshot). No BFF caching for `skuName` — legacy `product` catalog stable read, LEFT JOIN happens at BE query time (BFF passthrough).

### 3i.4 Mobile scope

**VIEW + POST/UNPOST via V2 canonical ops** — Mobile FE (garage-mobile) consumes:
- `searchDeliveriesV2` (D1, W05-D1) cho list phiếu xuất
- `getDeliveryV2` (D2, W05-D2) cho chi tiết phiếu xuất
- `postDeliveryV2` (D5, W05-D5) cho Ghi sổ kho — 2 entry point (icon inline per-row trong LIST + button trong DETAIL)
- `unpostDeliveryV2` (D6, W05-D6) cho Bỏ ghi sổ kho — 2 entry point tương tự

**KHÔNG có Mobile-specific ops hoặc SDL types** — Mobile + Web dùng chung V2 schema per user Delivery Authority 2026-07-14 consolidation direction.

- **Enum labels** (`statusDescription`/`sourceDescription`/etc.): xử lý client-side (Mobile FE local mapping enum → VN label).
- **Lifecycle stamps + rich embedded objects** (customer/serviceOrder detail): Mobile FE query customer/SO riêng qua existing ops.
- **`attachments[]` shape**: consume V2 canonical shape (`id`/`fileUrl`/`fileName`/`fileType`/`fileSizeBytes`/`attachmentKind`/`createdBy`/`createdAt`).
- **`reconciliationWarnings[]`** (SO reconciliation ADR-024 D2 v6 + D5 v6 — v7.72 refine): Mobile FE consumes warnings **via 2-step postDeliveryV2 flow** (giống Web) — NOT via `getDeliveryV2` (D2) read (getDeliveryV2 response `reconciliationWarnings[]` là snapshot cached từ last-post case C2 clean only, không refresh). Mobile flow tại 2 entry point (button trong Detail + icon inline per-row trong List): (i) user tap Ghi sổ → popup xác nhận chung; (ii) user Xác nhận → Mobile FE call `postDeliveryV2(id, key1, overrideWarnings: false)`; (iii) case C3 warning → BFF trả 409 + `warnings[]` payload → Mobile FE render popup "Đối soát đơn dịch vụ có sai lệch" per BR-IDV2-009 v39 với [Đóng] / [Vẫn Ghi sổ]; (iv) case C4 DEGRADED → Mobile FE render DEGRADED popup [Đóng] / [Vẫn Ghi sổ]; (v) user Vẫn Ghi sổ → Mobile FE re-call `postDeliveryV2(id, key2, overrideWarnings: true)` (new idempotencyKey) → BFF trả 200 case C5 commit. Read-only banner rendering trong Detail view = snapshot từ last-post case C2 clean (empty array). Mobile không có Create/Edit flow — createDeliveryV2 / updateDeliveryV2 KHÔNG applicable Mobile.

**Mobile-only writes** (create/edit/delete/print/export/inherit): **NOT SUPPORTED**; **post/unpost: SUPPORTED** per BA v12 direction 2026-07-16 (GAP-01 pre-DEV W05 rà soát — mirror `FEAT-ID-DETAIL-V2` v12 AC-4 mobile carve-out + `FEAT-ID-LIST-V2` mobile icon inline per-row + `UX-FLOW-INVENTORY-DELIVERY-V2` §Scope App Garage symmetric Receipt). Mobile hub `FEAT-INV-MOBILE-MENU` tile "Phiếu xuất" → tap → mobile route wired to `searchDeliveriesV2` + `getDeliveryV2` + `postDeliveryV2` + `unpostDeliveryV2`. Popup xác nhận verbatim share với FEAT-ID-DETAIL-V2 AC-5/AC-6. Error codes pass-through identical Web (`ERR-INV-011/024/036/037/039/CONFLICT` + `ERR-CMN-*`); `reconciliationWarnings[]` warning-only tại post-time per BR-IDV2-009.

**Deprecation note** (v7.70 S3n-consolidate 2026-07-14): Legacy Mobile ops `searchDeliveriesMobile`/`getMobileDeliveryById`/`getDeliveryItems` đã removed. Mobile FE cần migrate queries theo V2 canonical field naming (`deliveryCode`→`code`, `items`→`lines`, `productName`→`internalProductName` V2 shape, `unitOfMeasure`→`mainUnitCode`, `deliveryType`→`type`, etc.). Legacy queries còn tồn tại chỉ trong Change Log audit trail (v7.62/v7.1 rows).

Module `gf-inventory/delivery-v2` (DESIGN — W05, ADR-023/024): **11 operations** (5 query + 6 mutation) — full CRUD + state-change + delete + print + export + cross-slip lookup + inherit-from-purchase. Total module count BFF DESIGN scope hiện tại: catalog-v2 (23) + accounting-period (7) + opening-balance (7) + receipt-v2 (11) + delivery-v2 (11) = **59 operations** — matches `agg-garage-graph-HLD.md §1 W05 subsystem callout` ~55 ops target (+4 refinement locking at S4 completion).

Error codes reused verbatim từ `gf-inventory-api.md §3d` per-op tables. Delivery-specific `reconciliationWarnings[]` populated conditionally when `serviceOrderCode` provided (create/update/post responses).

#### Query `searchDeliveriesV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `PagedDeliveryV2ApiResponse!`. Mirror `searchReceiptsV2` (§3h.6 R1) with Delivery-specific fields.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + `X-Tenant-Id` + `X-Branch-Id`. **Idempotency**: Read-only.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2/search` | W05-D1 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) |

**Request** (default sort `entryDate,desc` tie-break `code,desc`; filter theo FEAT-ID-LIST-V2 AC-2..AC-6):
```json
{
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>", "x-request-id": "req-20260713-d1-0001" },
  "operationName": "searchDeliveriesV2",
  "query": "query searchDeliveriesV2($input: DeliveryV2SearchInput!) { searchDeliveriesV2(input: $input) { __typename ... on PagedDeliveryV2Response { __typename success code message data { __typename content { __typename id code status source type objectType objectId objectName entryDate warehouseId warehouseCode staffId stockKeeperName serviceOrderCode description totalValue totalLineCount postedBy postedAt createdBy createdByName createdAt updatedBy updatedByName updatedAt } totalElements totalPages page size aggregates { __typename totalValue } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code serverResponse message statusCode path timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "keyword": "PX-00033",
      "source": "EXTERNAL",
      "type": "DELIVERY_SALE",
      "status": "POSTED",
      "objectType": "CUSTOMER",
      "objectId": "8f14e45f-ceea-467a-9575-abcde12345f7",
```

#### Query `getDeliveryV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `DeliveryV2DetailApiResponse!`. Mirror `getReceiptV2` (§3h.6 R2).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + tenant. **Idempotency**: Read-only.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `GET` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2/{id}` | W05-D2 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) |

**Request**:
```json

}
```

#### Mutation `createDeliveryV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `DeliveryV2DetailApiResponse!`. Mirror `createReceiptV2` (§3h.6 R3) plus `reconciliationWarnings[]` when `serviceOrderCode` provided.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + tenant. **Idempotency**: REQUIRED per R3 pattern.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2` | W05-D3 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) with header `X-Idempotency-Key` |

**Request** (create DRAFT; `postOnSave=true` triggers ledger cascade AND SO reconciliation when `serviceOrderCode` set — per ADR-023 D4 + ADR-024 D2):

```json
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "type": "DELIVERY_SALE",
      "source": "EXTERNAL",
      "objectType": "CUSTOMER",
      "objectId": "8f14e45f-ceea-467a-9575-abcde12345f7",
      "objectName": "Khách hàng ABC",
      "entryDate": "2026-06-15",
      "warehouseId": 12,
      "staffId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
      "serviceOrderCode": "SO-2026-0456",
      "batchCode": "LOT-2026-Q2-088",
      "delivererName": "Trần Văn Vận (Viettel Post)",
      "sourceReceiptCode": null,
      "description": "Xuất bán lô lốp",
      "postOnSave": false,
      "lines": [
        { "lineNo": 1, "productId": 4400, "warehouseId": 12, "unitCode": "CAI", "conversionRate": 1, "quantity": 5, "unitPrice": 2400000, "sourceCode": null, "sourceLineId": null, "manualPriceOverride": false, "note": "Giao khách trực tiếp" }
      ],
      "attachments": []
    },
    "idempotencyKey": "cd8f0b1e-8a2f-4c1a-9d5e-1122334455ff"
  }
}
```

**Response 200** (v7.72 narrow per ADR-024 D2 v6 + BR-IDV2-009 v39 + Q1=No + finding A6 P0): createDelivery LUÔN trả `reconciliationWarnings: []` empty regardless of `postOnSave`/`serviceOrderCode` — reconciliation là post-only via explicit `postDeliveryV2` mutation. Slip DRAFT ghi thành công; response semantic v7.71 legacy warnings populated đã bị loại bỏ v7.72:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "createDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "DeliveryV2DetailResponse",
      "success": true, "code": "OK", "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "DeliveryV2Detail",
        "id": 8001, "code": "PX-00033", "status": "DRAFT", "source": "EXTERNAL", "type": "DELIVERY_SALE",

        "lines": [ { "__typename": "DeliveryV2Line", "id": 82011, "lineNo": 1, "productId": 4400, "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "productName": "Lốp 175/70R13", "sku": "BRDG-B250-17570R13", "skuName": "Lốp Bridgestone Turanza 175/70R13", "warehouseId": 12, "warehouseCode": "WH-01", "unitCode": "CAI", "mainUnitCode": "CAI", "conversionRate": 1, "quantity": 5, "quantityInBase": 5, "unitPrice": 2400000, "valueBase": 12000000, "costUnitPrice": 0, "manualPriceOverride": false, "note": "Giao khách trực tiếp" } ],
```


**Error codes**: Same as R3 with Delivery-specific v7.72 narrow: `ERR-INV-039` + `ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED` **KHÔNG surface trong createDelivery** (v7.72 change per ADR-024 D2 v6 + finding A5/A6 P0) — createDelivery never triggers reconciliation. Warnings semantic moved to `postDeliveryV2` mutation only (2-step commit — case C3/C4 return 409). Otherwise mirror R3 codes.

#### Mutation `updateDeliveryV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `DeliveryV2DetailApiResponse!`. Mirror `updateReceiptV2` (§3h.6 R4).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + tenant. **Idempotency**: REQUIRED.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `PUT` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2/{id}` | W05-D4 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) with header `X-Idempotency-Key` |

**Request** (diff-by-id semantic; POSTED edit auto-triggers engine cascade `SLIP_EDITED` per ADR-023 D3. **KHÔNG re-triggers SO reconciliation** per BR-IDV2-009 v39 + ADR-024 D2 v6 narrow post-only — reconciliation CHỈ tại W05-D5 `postDeliveryV2` với `overrideWarnings=false`; `updateDeliveryV2` response `reconciliationWarnings[]` LUÔN EMPTY bất kể `serviceOrderCode` / `postOnSave` / edit path):
```json
{
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>", "x-request-id": "req-20260713-d4-0001" },
  "operationName": "updateDeliveryV2",
  "query": "mutation updateDeliveryV2($id: Int!, $input: UpdateDeliveryV2Input!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { updateDeliveryV2(id: $id, input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on DeliveryV2DetailResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename id code status entryDate warehouseCode postedAt updatedAt lines { __typename id lineNo productCode sku skuName unitCode mainUnitCode quantity unitPrice valueBase } reconciliationWarnings { __typename code message lineIndex } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code message statusCode timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": {
    "id": 8001,
    "input": {
      "type": "DELIVERY_SALE", "source": "EXTERNAL", "objectType": "CUSTOMER",
      "objectId": "8f14e45f-ceea-467a-9575-abcde12345f7", "objectName": "Khách hàng ABC",
      "entryDate": "2026-06-15", "warehouseId": 12, "staffId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
      "serviceOrderCode": "SO-2026-0456", "description": "Xuất bán — sửa SL",
      "postOnSave": false,
      "lines": [ { "id": 82011, "lineNo": 1, "productId": 4400, "warehouseId": 12, "unitCode": "CAI", "conversionRate": 1, "quantity": 4, "unitPrice": 2400000, "manualPriceOverride": false } ],
      "attachments": []
    },
    "idempotencyKey": "de9f0b1e-8a2f-4c1a-9d5e-11223344500a"
  }
}
```

**Response 200** (v7.72 narrow per ADR-024 D2 v6 + finding A7 P1): updateDelivery LUÔN trả `reconciliationWarnings: []` empty bất kể edit path (edit-DRAFT / edit-POSTED / postOnSave) hoặc thay đổi `serviceOrderCode` — reconciliation là post-only, edit NEVER triggers gf-sales call. Nếu FE muốn re-check reconciliation sau edit → phải call `postDeliveryV2` explicit:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "updateDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "DeliveryV2DetailResponse",
      "success": true, "code": "OK", "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "DeliveryV2Detail",
        "id": 8001, "code": "PX-00033", "status": "POSTED",
        "entryDate": "2026-06-15", "warehouseCode": "WH-01",
        "postedAt": "2026-06-15T14:00:00Z", "updatedAt": "2026-07-13T10:20:00Z",
        "lines": [ { "__typename": "DeliveryV2Line", "id": 82011, "lineNo": 1, "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "sku": "BRDG-B250-17570R13", "skuName": "Lốp Bridgestone Turanza 175/70R13", "unitCode": "CAI", "mainUnitCode": "CAI", "quantity": 4, "unitPrice": 2400000, "valueBase": 9600000 } ],
        "reconciliationWarnings": []
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "updateDeliveryV2": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "id": "err-20260713-d4-0001", "code": "ERR-INV-036", "message": "Sửa gây tồn âm point-in-time", "statusCode": 422, "path": "/graphql", "timestamp": "2026-07-13T10:20:00Z", "details": { "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "warehouseCode": "WH-01" } } } }
```

**Error codes**: Same as R4 with Delivery-specific v7.72 narrow (per ADR-024 D2 v6 + finding A5/A7): `ERR-INV-039` + `ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED` **KHÔNG surface trong updateDelivery** — updateDelivery never triggers reconciliation. Warnings semantic moved to `postDeliveryV2` mutation only.

#### Mutation `postDeliveryV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `PostDeliveryV2ResultApiResponse!`. Mirror `postReceiptV2` (§3h.6 R5) plus `reconciliationWarnings[]`.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + tenant. **Idempotency**: REQUIRED.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2/{id}/post` | W05-D5 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) with header `X-Idempotency-Key` |

**Request** — v7.72 add `overrideWarnings` param per ADR-024 D5 v6 + Q2=Option (i). State transition `DRAFT → POSTED`; engine `SLIP_POSTED` origin; SO reconciliation call **chỉ khi `overrideWarnings=false` + `serviceOrderCode` set** (case C2/C3/C4); `overrideWarnings=true` SKIP gf-sales (case C5):
```json
{
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>", "x-request-id": "req-20260713-d5-0001" },
  "operationName": "postDeliveryV2",
  "query": "mutation postDeliveryV2($id: Int!, $idempotencyKey: String!, $overrideWarnings: Boolean) { postDeliveryV2(id: $id, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey, overrideWarnings: $overrideWarnings) { __typename ... on PostDeliveryV2ResultResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename id code status postedBy postedAt cascadeSummary { __typename affectedRows cascadedKeys { __typename productCode warehouseCode closingQtyDelta closingValueDelta } } reconciliationWarnings { __typename code message lineIndex productCode warehouseCode expectedFromSo actualFromDelivery } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code message statusCode timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": { "id": 8001, "idempotencyKey": "ef0f0b1e-8a2f-4c1a-9d5e-11223344500b", "overrideWarnings": false }
}
```

**Response 200 — case C2 clean commit** (`closingValueDelta = 0` per ADR-023 D6 — Delivery giá vốn cost=0 tại W05; PWA M3 future update retrospectively; `reconciliationWarnings[]` empty vì line SL khớp SO — case C2 per ADR-024 D5 v6):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "postDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "PostDeliveryV2ResultResponse",
      "success": true, "code": "OK", "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "PostDeliveryV2Result",
        "id": 8001, "code": "PX-00033", "status": "POSTED",
        "postedBy": "operator@garage.com", "postedAt": "2026-07-13T10:30:00Z",
        "cascadeSummary": {
          "__typename": "SlipCascadeSummary",
          "affectedRows": 3,
          "cascadedKeys": [
            { "__typename": "SlipCascadeKey", "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "warehouseCode": "WH-01", "closingQtyDelta": -4, "closingValueDelta": 0 }
          ]
        },
        "reconciliationWarnings": []
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Response 409 — case C3 reconciliation warning (NO commit, phiếu giữ Nháp)** — v7.72 add per ADR-024 D5 v6:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "postDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "ErrorResponse",
      "id": "err-20260713-d5-c3-0001",
      "code": "ERR-INV-039-RECONCILIATION-WARNING",
      "message": "Đối soát đơn dịch vụ có sai lệch — vui lòng xác nhận",
      "statusCode": 409,
      "path": "/graphql",
      "timestamp": "2026-07-16T10:30:00Z",
      "details": {
        "serviceOrderCode": "SO-2026-0456",
        "warnings": [
          { "code": "ERR-INV-039", "message": "line 1: SL lệch (SO=4, phiếu=5)", "lineIndex": 1, "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "warehouseCode": "WH-01", "expectedFromSo": 4, "actualFromDelivery": 5 }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

FE parse `details.warnings[]` → render popup "Đối soát đơn dịch vụ có sai lệch — bạn có muốn tiếp tục Ghi sổ?" với [Đóng] / [Vẫn Ghi sổ]. User [Vẫn Ghi sổ] → re-call postDeliveryV2 với `overrideWarnings: true` + new idempotencyKey → case C5 skip gf-sales + commit success.

**Response 409 — case C4 DEGRADED gf-sales unreachable (NO commit, phiếu giữ Nháp)** — v7.72 add per ADR-024 D5 v6:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "postDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "ErrorResponse",
      "id": "err-20260713-d5-c4-0001",
      "code": "ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED",
      "message": "Không thể đối soát với đơn dịch vụ — SO không phản hồi",
      "statusCode": 409,
      "path": "/graphql",
      "timestamp": "2026-07-16T10:30:00Z",
      "details": {
        "serviceOrderCode": "SO-2026-0456",
        "warnings": [
          { "code": "ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED", "message": "Không thể đối soát với đơn dịch vụ — SO không phản hồi" }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

FE render DEGRADED popup "Không thể đối soát với đơn dịch vụ — bạn có muốn tiếp tục Ghi sổ?" với [Đóng] / [Vẫn Ghi sổ]. User [Vẫn Ghi sổ] → re-call postDeliveryV2 với `overrideWarnings: true` → case C5 skip gf-sales + commit success.

**Error response shape (guards fatal — 4xx per ADR-024 D5 v6 guards ATOMIC regardless of overrideWarnings)**:
```json
{ "data": { "postDeliveryV2": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "id": "err-20260713-d5-0001", "code": "ERR-INV-037", "message": "Tồn âm point-in-time — dòng SP-NB-000123 kho WH-01 (available=3, requested=4)", "statusCode": 422, "path": "/graphql", "timestamp": "2026-07-13T10:30:00Z", "details": { "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "warehouseCode": "WH-01" } } } }
```

**Error codes**:
| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `ERR-INV-037` | 422 | Tồn âm point-in-time (post insufficient — Delivery removes stock) per BR-IDV2-008. Guards ATOMIC — check trước warning branch. |
| `ERR-INV-011` | 400 | `productId` NULL khi post per BR-IDV2-028 (Ghi sổ enforce line productId NOT NULL). |
| `ERR-INV-024` | 422 | Kỳ đã khóa per ADR-021 fail-CLOSED. |
| `ERR-INV-036` | 422 | Reverse cascade drift downstream. |
| `ERR-INV-038` | 422 | OB guard `entryDate ≤ OB.asOfDate` per BR-IDV2-030. |
| `ERR-INV-040` | 422 | SL Xuất trả mua vượt SL Nhập mua gốc per BR-IDV2-030. |
| `ERR-INV-039-RECONCILIATION-WARNING` | **409** | **v7.72 add** — `overrideWarnings=false` + `serviceOrderCode!=null` + gf-sales trả warning (SL/sản phẩm lệch). NO commit, phiếu giữ Nháp. FE render warning popup [Đóng]/[Vẫn Ghi sổ]. Cite ADR-024 D5 v6 case C3. |
| `ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED` | **409** | **v7.72 add** — `overrideWarnings=false` + `serviceOrderCode!=null` + gf-sales unreachable/5xx/timeout. NO commit, phiếu giữ Nháp. FE render DEGRADED popup. Cite ADR-024 D5 v6 case C4. Bản v7.71 fail-OPEN commit+marker semantic legacy removed. |
| `ERR-CMN-CONFLICT` | 409 | Slip đã POSTED (state transition invalid); non-idempotent 2nd caller. |
| `ERR-CMN-007` | 503 | `gf-accounting` AP lock-check unreachable per ADR-021 fail-CLOSED. gf-sales unreachable KHÔNG throw 503 (v7.72 change: gf-sales unreachable = 409 `ERR-CMN-007-DEGRADED` per D5 v6 case C4, không phải 503 fail-OPEN commit legacy). |

#### Mutation `unpostDeliveryV2`

Module: `delivery-v2`. Return type: `PostDeliveryV2ResultApiResponse!`. Mirror `unpostReceiptV2` (§3h.6 R6).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`. **Auth**: JWT + tenant. **Idempotency**: REQUIRED.
**Downstream**:

| REST target | Method | Path | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v2/deliveries-v2/{id}/unpost` | W05-D6 (`gf-inventory-api.md §3d.2`) with header `X-Idempotency-Key` |

**Request** (state `POSTED → DRAFT`; engine `SLIP_REVERSED`; no SO reconciliation on unpost — status transition doesn't re-trigger warnings):
```json
{
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>", "x-request-id": "req-20260713-d6-0001" },
  "operationName": "unpostDeliveryV2",
  "query": "mutation unpostDeliveryV2($id: Int!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { unpostDeliveryV2(id: $id, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on PostDeliveryV2ResultResponse { __typename success code message data { __typename id code status postedBy postedAt cascadeSummary { __typename affectedRows cascadedKeys { __typename productCode warehouseCode closingQtyDelta closingValueDelta } } reconciliationWarnings { __typename code message } } } ... on ErrorResponse { __typename id code message statusCode timestamp details } } }",
  "variables": { "id": 8001, "idempotencyKey": "f01f0b1e-8a2f-4c1a-9d5e-11223344500c" }
}
```

**Response 200** (reverse cascade — SL trở lại kho; `reconciliationWarnings` null / empty for unpost):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "unpostDeliveryV2": {
      "__typename": "PostDeliveryV2ResultResponse",
      "success": true, "code": "OK", "message": "Success",
      "data": {
        "__typename": "PostDeliveryV2Result",
        "id": 8001, "code": "PX-00033", "status": "DRAFT",
        "postedBy": null, "postedAt": null,
        "cascadeSummary": {
          "__typename": "SlipCascadeSummary",
          "affectedRows": 3,
          "cascadedKeys": [ { "__typename": "SlipCascadeKey", "productCode": "SP-NB-000123", "warehouseCode": "WH-01", "closingQtyDelta": 4, "closingValueDelta": 0 } ]
        },
        "reconciliationWarnings": []
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "unpostDeliveryV2": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "id": "err-20260713-d6-0001", "code": "ERR-INV-CONFLICT", "message": "Slip đã DRAFT — không thể unpost", "statusCode": 409, "path": "/graphql", "timestamp": "2026-07-13T11:00:00Z", "details": {} } } }
```

**Error codes**: Same as R6 (unpost) — 409 khi đã DRAFT; 422 khi kỳ khóa; 503 khi AP down.

## 3f. PRC — Price Calculation Run (DESIGN — W06, ADR-027 + ADR-028)

> **Scope**: 6 GraphQL operations passthrough sang `gf-accounting /api/v2/price-calc-runs/*` cho 5 màn PRC trên Web GMS (FEAT-PRC-LIST/CREATE/DETAIL/RECALC/DELETE). Backend authority = `gf-accounting`. BFF passthrough thuần — không orchestrate, không aggregate, không cache. Feature-flag gate `Inventory:InventoryV2` áp tại BE (BFF forward request bình thường, BE trả 403 khi flag off → BFF map lên `FORBIDDEN_ERROR`).
>
> **Naming Registry**: BFF `-graphql.md` KHÔNG lặp registry — reference [`gf-accounting-api.md §6.2 Price Calc Run + §6.3 Price Calc Run Item`](gf-accounting-api.md) cho canonical field/enum names BE↔BFF↔FE↔Mobile. Alien field trong Request/Response mà không có row trong `§6.2/§6.3` → Reviewer G11 P0.
>
> **`averageUnitPrice` canonical**: field BE = `averageUnitPrice: BigDecimal(scale=2)`; **UI microcopy VN = "Giá bình quân"** (rename từ "Đơn giá bình quân" per FEAT-PRC-DETAIL v17 — presentation layer only). SDL name = `averageUnitPrice` — **KHÔNG rename ở BFF/FE/Mobile** (Phase 5b rule).
>
> **HTTP 202 kick-off**: `priceCalcRunCreate` + `priceCalcRunRecalc` là async kick-off (ADR-028 §1). BFF passthrough giữ nguyên semantic HTTP 202 từ `gf-accounting`; response envelope trả `status: PENDING` + `pollingUrl` + `pollingIntervalHint: 5000`. FE polling qua `priceCalcRunGet` với `includeItems: true` + `itemStatus: [DONE, ERROR]` filter (5s interval per FEAT-PRC-DETAIL AC-2c).
>
> **Idempotency**: BFF forward `idempotencyKey` variable → REST header `X-Idempotency-Key: {value}` xuống BE per ADR-028 §1. Client sinh key deterministic: `PRC-CREATE-{tenantId}-{periodId}-{warehouseId}-{clientNonce}` (create) hoặc `PRC-RECALC-{runId}-{clientNonce}` (recalc). Window 5 phút BE-side.

### 3f.1 SDL types (chỉ liệt kê SDL mới — canonical field per §6.2/§6.3 `gf-accounting-api.md`)

```graphql
"Log/lần tính giá (PWA) per period+warehouse — canonical fields per gf-accounting-api.md §6.2."
type PriceCalcRun {
  id: Int!
  periodId: Int!
  periodName: String!
  fromDate: Date!
  toDate: Date!
  warehouseId: Int!
  warehouseCode: String!
  warehouseName: String!
  pricingMethod: PricingMethod!
  executedBy: String!
  "BFF-populated nullable — mirror OB pattern §3g agg-garage-graph (TENANT-USERS DataLoader qua gf-hrms)."
  executedByName: String
  executedAt: DateTime!
  scope: PriceCalcScope!
  status: PriceCalcRunStatus!
  itemsResolvedCount: Int!
  itemsDoneCount: Int!
  itemsErrorCount: Int!
  warningsSkippedItems: Int!
}

"Chi tiết per mã trong 1 PRC run — canonical fields per gf-accounting-api.md §6.3."
type PriceCalcRunItem {
  id: Int!
  productCode: String!
  productName: String!
  mainUnitCode: String!
  openingQty: Decimal!
  openingValue: Decimal!
  receiptQty: Decimal!
  receiptValue: Decimal!
  deliveryQty: Decimal!
  "Nullable khi item ERROR — DONE = round(averageUnitPrice × deliveryQty, 0 VND)."
  deliveryValue: Decimal
  "'Giá bình quân' (VN UI microcopy per FEAT-PRC-DETAIL v17). SDL name = averageUnitPrice — canonical."
  averageUnitPrice: Decimal
  updatedDeliverySlipCount: Int!
  status: PriceCalcItemStatus!
  errorReason: PriceCalcErrorReason
  iterationsApplied: Int!
}

"PRC detail response — extend PriceCalcRun với scopePredicate + progress + items[] + aggregates (F-15 v7.76)."
type PriceCalcRunDetail {
  run: PriceCalcRun!
  scopePredicate: JSON!
  progressPercent: Int!
  progressItemsTotal: Int!
  progressItemsDone: Int!
  items: [PriceCalcRunItem!]!
  "F-15 v7.76 (Round 5 add). Dòng Tổng BE-computed across full filtered scope (before pagination) — cover FEAT-PRC-DETAIL AC-3 'dòng Tổng' (Σ openingQty/Value + receiptQty/Value + deliveryQty/Value + updatedDeliverySlipCount + itemsCount). Passthrough gf-accounting `§5.2` `aggregates` block verbatim. **Always non-null** (empty scope → all zeros + `itemsCount: 0`); `includeItems=false` polling case (progress-only) VẪN trả aggregates để FE render Tổng bar mà không cần fetch items[]."
  aggregates: PriceCalcRunItemsAggregates!
}

"F-15 v7.76 (Round 5 add). BE-computed aggregate across full filtered scope (post server-side filter, pre-pagination) cho FEAT-PRC-DETAIL AC-3 'dòng Tổng'. Names + types khớp verbatim `gf-accounting-api.md §5.2` `aggregates` block (BE canonical)."
type PriceCalcRunItemsAggregates {
  "Σ tồn đầu kỳ (SL) — mirror `items[].openingQty` semantic."
  openingQtyTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ tồn đầu kỳ (GT) — mirror `items[].openingValue` semantic."
  openingValueTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ nhập trong kỳ (SL)."
  receiptQtyTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ nhập trong kỳ (GT)."
  receiptValueTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ xuất trong kỳ (SL)."
  deliveryQtyTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ xuất trong kỳ (GT). Nullable-per-item collapsed sang 0 khi item ERROR (deliveryValue=null); BE skip ERROR values trong SUM để tránh corrupt total (BR-PRC-013 v22)."
  deliveryValueTotal: Decimal!
  "Σ số phiếu xuất được cập nhật giá vốn cross-boundary (BR-PRC-005)."
  updatedDeliverySlipCountTotal: Int!
  "Tổng số mã trong scope filtered (trước pagination) — dùng cho FE hiển thị 'Tổng X mã' và phân biệt với `run.itemsResolvedCount` (post-filter vs post-resolve)."
  itemsCount: Int!
}

"Kick-off response — CREATE + RECALC common shape."
type PriceCalcRunKickoff {
  runId: Int!
  status: PriceCalcRunStatus!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  pollingUrl: String!
  pollingIntervalHint: Int!
  "Optional cho RECALC: run gốc để audit trail (BR-PRC-010)."
  sourceRunId: Int
  "Optional cho RECALC: scope truyền vào (ALL | ERROR_ONLY)."
  runScope: PriceCalcRunScope
  warningsSkippedItems: Int
  warningsMessages: [PriceCalcWarning!]
  "true khi replay idempotent trong 5 phút window (HTTP 200 thay vì 202)."
  idempotentReplay: Boolean
  "F-13 v7.76 (Round 5 add). Cảnh báo các kỳ sau đã tính giá cần chạy lại vì kỳ hiện tại thay đổi giá vốn/sổ tồn (BR-PRC-002 cascade → BR-PRC-015). Non-blocking advisory forwarded verbatim từ REST `gf-accounting-api.md §5.3/§5.4 affectedSubsequentPeriods`. Empty array `[]` = không có kỳ sau nào đã tính (case thường: kỳ hiện tại là kỳ gần nhất). Null = detection chưa chạy (defensive; FE treat as empty). FE render toast/panel per FEAT-PRC-CREATE AC-9b + FEAT-PRC-RECALC BR-PRC-015; user tự trigger RECALC cho mỗi period liệt kê."
  affectedSubsequentPeriods: [AffectedSubsequentPeriod!]
}

"F-13 v7.76 (Round 5 add). Cảnh báo 1 kỳ sau đã tính giá bị ảnh hưởng cascade — payload passthrough từ REST `gf-accounting-api.md §5.3` verbatim (BR-PRC-015 + FEAT-PRC-CREATE AC-9b)."
type AffectedSubsequentPeriod {
  "ID kỳ kế toán sau — trỏ tới `accounting_period.id`, cùng tenant + warehouse."
  periodId: Int!
  "Tên kỳ (denorm snapshot) để FE render trực tiếp trong warning panel — không cần lookup thêm."
  periodName: String!
  "ID run gốc của kỳ sau (successful) — deep-link cho UI 'Xem chi tiết' hoặc kick RECALC target."
  lastRunId: Int!
  "Trạng thái run gốc kỳ sau — SUCCEEDED hoặc COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS (BE chỉ populate khi run terminal thành công)."
  lastRunStatus: PriceCalcRunStatus!
}

type PriceCalcWarning {
  type: PriceCalcWarningType!
  count: Int!
}

enum PriceCalcWarningType {
  PRODUCT_INACTIVE_SKIPPED
  PRODUCT_NON_PWA_SKIPPED
}

enum PricingMethod { PWA }
enum PriceCalcScope { ALL SPECIFIC }
enum PriceCalcRunStatus { PENDING RUNNING SUCCEEDED COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS }
enum PriceCalcItemStatus { RUNNING DONE ERROR }
enum PriceCalcErrorReason { NEGATIVE_STOCK ACCOUNTING_MISMATCH SYSTEM_ERROR }
enum PriceCalcRunScope { ALL ERROR_ONLY }

"Input types"
input PriceCalcRunSearchInput {
  warehouseId: Int
  pricingMethod: PricingMethod
  executedFrom: Date
  executedTo: Date
  page: Int = 0
  size: Int = 20
  sort: String = "executedAt,desc"
}

input PriceCalcRunCreateInput {
  periodId: Int!
  warehouseId: Int!
  pricingMethod: PricingMethod!
  scope: PriceCalcScope!
  items: [PriceCalcRunCreateItemInput!]
}

input PriceCalcRunCreateItemInput {
  productCode: String!
}

input PriceCalcRunRecalcInput {
  runScope: PriceCalcRunScope!
}

input PriceCalcItemsForCogsLookupInput {
  periodId: Int!
  warehouseId: Int!
  keyword: String
  page: Int = 0
  size: Int = 20
}

"Response wrappers — union `type | ErrorResponse`."
type PagedPriceCalcRunApiResponse { data: PagedPriceCalcRunData }
type PagedPriceCalcRunData {
  content: [PriceCalcRun!]!
  totalElements: Int!
  totalPages: Int!
  page: Int!
  size: Int!
}
type PriceCalcRunDetailApiResponse { data: PriceCalcRunDetail }
type PriceCalcRunKickoffApiResponse { data: PriceCalcRunKickoff }
type PriceCalcRunDeleteApiResponse { data: PriceCalcRunDeleteResult }
type PriceCalcRunDeleteResult { runId: Int!, deleted: Boolean!, message: String! }
type PagedPriceCalcItemsForCogsLookupApiResponse { data: PagedPriceCalcItemsForCogsLookupData }
type PagedPriceCalcItemsForCogsLookupData {
  content: [PriceCalcItemForCogsLookup!]!
  totalElements: Int!
  totalPages: Int!
  page: Int!
  size: Int!
}
type PriceCalcItemForCogsLookup {
  productCode: String!
  productName: String!
  mainUnitCode: String!
  hasDeliveryInPeriod: Boolean!
  deliveryCountInPeriod: Int!
  lastCalculatedAt: DateTime
}
```

### 3f.3 Resolver discipline

- **Passthrough thuần**: mọi resolver `priceCalcRun*` gọi `PassthroughService.request({ downstream: 'gf-accounting', method, path, headers, body })`. Không aggregate cross-boundary, không enrichment ngoài `executedByName` (xem dưới).
- **`executedByName` BFF-enrichment**: mirror OB pattern `§3g` — DataLoader `TenantUsersLoader` per-request (batch key auth+tenant-aware), input `executedBy` (email/username) → output `displayName` từ `gf-hrms` `POST /api/v1/employees/lookup-by-tenant-user` (cap 100/batch, timeout 500ms → nullable fallback). Field-level: chỉ tính khi client select `executedByName`.
- **Idempotency-Key forwarding**: `idempotencyKey` variable trong `priceCalcRunCreate` + `priceCalcRunRecalc` → REST header `X-Idempotency-Key: {value}` verbatim; không sinh key BFF-side.
- **`affectedSubsequentPeriods[]` verbatim passthrough** (F-13 v7.76 Round 5): BFF forward `affectedSubsequentPeriods[]` từ REST response `gf-accounting-api.md §5.3/§5.4` verbatim — KHÔNG aggregate, KHÔNG filter, KHÔNG enrichment cross-boundary (Product term VN "Cảnh báo các kỳ sau cần tính lại" là presentation-layer; FE renders warning panel post-submit per FEAT-PRC-CREATE AC-9b + FEAT-PRC-RECALC BR-PRC-015). Payload shape identical CREATE + RECALC (symmetric). Empty `[]` treated by FE = no warning to show; null (defensive) = detection chưa chạy = treat as empty.
- **Feature-flag**: KHÔNG check BFF-side. BE `PriceCalcRunController` class-level `@RequiresFeatureFlag(FeatureFlag.INVENTORY_V2)` → khi off trả 403 → BFF map lên `FORBIDDEN_ERROR`.
- **Polling optimization**: FE truyền `includeItems: false` trong header-only poll (progress bar refresh) và `includeItems: true` khi mở expandable panel items[]. BFF không cache — passthrough thuần.
- **`aggregates` block verbatim passthrough** (F-15 v7.76 Round 5): BFF forward `aggregates` field trong DETAIL response từ REST `gf-accounting-api.md §5.2` verbatim — KHÔNG tự SUM lại từ paginated `items[]` (sẽ sai vì chỉ có current page). BE computes across full filtered scope (post server-side filter `itemStatus`/`keyword`, pre-pagination). Always non-null bất kể `includeItems` flag — cover FEAT-PRC-DETAIL AC-3 "dòng Tổng" và cho phép FE render Tổng bar khi poll tiết kiệm (`includeItems: false`).
- **Feature flag polling backoff**: khi BE trả `status=RUNNING` liên tục, FE nên back off exponential `5s → 5s → 10s → 15s → 30s cap` sau 5 poll cycles không đổi progress (advisory — không phải BFF concern).

### 3f.4 Web + Mobile scope

- **Web GMS**: 6/6 ops SUPPORTED — 5 màn FEAT-PRC-LIST/CREATE/DETAIL/RECALC/DELETE + 1 lookup dropdown (embedded trong CREATE modal AC-6).
- **Mobile (App Garage)**: **KHÔNG SUPPORTED** — PRC entirely web-only per `EP-INVENTORY-ACCOUNTING-PERIOD §3.2` + FEAT-PRC-* `Platform scope: Web GMS only`. Hub tile "Tính giá" KHÔNG có trong mobile state matrix (FEAT-INV-MOBILE-MENU). Mobile SDK client (Flutter) MUST NOT emit `priceCalcRun*` queries; nếu emit → BE 403 (feature-flag or permission — depending BE decision).

### 3f.5 Operation count footer

Total W06 PRC operations: **6 ops** — 4 Query (`priceCalcRunList`, `priceCalcRunGet`, `priceCalcItemsForCogsLookup`) + 3 Mutation (`priceCalcRunCreate`, `priceCalcRunRecalc`, `priceCalcRunDelete`). Sum tallies to §2 Endpoint Summary rows 360-365.

_Note_: 4 Query + 3 Mutation appears to sum to 7 but rows 360-365 = 6 ops; `priceCalcRunList` + `priceCalcRunGet` + `priceCalcItemsForCogsLookup` = 3 Query + 3 Mutation (`priceCalcRunCreate`, `priceCalcRunRecalc`, `priceCalcRunDelete`) = 6 ops correct.

#### Mutation `priceCalcRunCreate` (W06-3)

Kick-off async PRC run. HTTP 202 semantic. FE nhận `runId` + `pollingUrl` → chuyển vào polling.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant + branch; dual persona `accountant` + `garage-owner` (BR-AP-CMN-002).
**Idempotency**: Client sinh `idempotencyKey` deterministic; BFF forward → BE dedupe 5-min window (ADR-028 §1). Replay cùng key trong window → HTTP 200 với `idempotentReplay: true` thay vì 202.

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-accounting` | `POST` | `/api/v2/price-calc-runs` (header `X-Idempotency-Key`) |

**Request**:
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "X-Tenant-Id": "42",
    "X-Branch-Id": "1"
  },
  "operationName": "priceCalcRunCreate",
  "query": "mutation priceCalcRunCreate($input: PriceCalcRunCreateInput!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { priceCalcRunCreate(input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on PriceCalcRunKickoffApiResponse { data { runId status createdAt pollingUrl pollingIntervalHint warningsSkippedItems warningsMessages { type count } idempotentReplay affectedSubsequentPeriods { periodId periodName lastRunId lastRunStatus } } } ... on ErrorResponse { code message statusCode path timestamp } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "periodId": 5001,
      "warehouseId": 12,
      "pricingMethod": "PWA",
      "scope": "SPECIFIC",
      "items": [
        { "productCode": "SP-NB-000123" },
        { "productCode": "SP-NB-000456" }
      ]
    },
    "idempotencyKey": "PRC-CREATE-42-5001-12-a1b2c3d4"
  }
}
```

Empty array `[]` = không có kỳ sau nào đã tính (case thường: kỳ hiện tại là kỳ gần nhất). FE render toast/warning-panel per FEAT-PRC-CREATE AC-9b + BR-PRC-015; per row deep-link "Xem chi tiết" (dùng `lastRunId`) hoặc kick RECALC target với `periodId`.

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "priceCalcRunCreate": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "code": "ERR-INV-024", "message": "Kỳ kế toán đã đóng — vui lòng chọn kỳ khác hoặc mở lại kỳ", "statusCode": 409, "path": "/api/v2/price-calc-runs", "timestamp": "2026-07-22T10:15:00Z", "details": { "periodId": 5001, "periodStatus": "CLOSED" } } } }
```

**Error codes**:

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch; feature flag off |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | Body invalid: `periodId` không tồn tại; `warehouseId` không tồn tại; `items[]` empty khi `scope=SPECIFIC`; items > 500 |
| `ERR-CMN-not-found` | 404 | Period / warehouse không thuộc tenant |
| `ERR-INV-024` | 409 | Period CLOSED (BR-PRC-008 + FEAT-PRC-CREATE AC-13b) |
| `ERR-INV-029` | 409 | Run-in-progress cùng `(period+warehouse)` (BR-PRC-016 + AC-13) |
| `ERR-INV-030` | 409 | Tồn âm invariant (BR-PRC-007) |
| Thread pool exhausted | 503 | ADR-028 §Risk-3 — client retry with backoff |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Downstream timeout |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected |

#### Mutation `priceCalcRunRecalc` (W06-4)

Kick-off NEW PRC run kế thừa scope từ run gốc. FEAT-PRC-RECALC: 2 sub-scope `ALL` (chạy lại toàn bộ, AC-1) / `ERROR_ONLY` (chỉ items status=ERROR, AC-1b).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant + branch; dual persona.
**Idempotency**: Client sinh `idempotencyKey = PRC-RECALC-{runId}-{clientNonce}`; BFF forward → BE dedupe 5-min window.

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-accounting` | `POST` | `/api/v2/price-calc-runs/{id}/recalc` (header `X-Idempotency-Key`) |

**Request**:
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "X-Tenant-Id": "42",
    "X-Branch-Id": "1"
  },
  "operationName": "priceCalcRunRecalc",
  "query": "mutation priceCalcRunRecalc($id: Int!, $input: PriceCalcRunRecalcInput!, $idempotencyKey: String!) { priceCalcRunRecalc(id: $id, input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { __typename ... on PriceCalcRunKickoffApiResponse { data { runId sourceRunId runScope status createdAt pollingUrl pollingIntervalHint warningsSkippedItems idempotentReplay affectedSubsequentPeriods { periodId periodName lastRunId lastRunStatus } } } ... on ErrorResponse { code message statusCode path timestamp } } }",
  "variables": {
    "id": 90123,
    "input": { "runScope": "ERROR_ONLY" },
    "idempotencyKey": "PRC-RECALC-90123-e5f6g7h8"
  }
}
```

> **F-13 v7.76 note (Round 5, symmetric với CREATE)**: RECALC cũng propagate BR-PRC-015 cascade — source run recompute → kỳ sau đã tính giá bị ảnh hưởng. Payload shape identical với `gf-accounting-api.md §5.4` Response 202 (F-05 v19). Non-blocking (advisory) — FE render toast/panel per FEAT-PRC-RECALC + BR-PRC-015.

```json
{ "data": { "priceCalcRunRecalc": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "code": "ERR-INV-029", "message": "Đã có lần tính đang chạy cùng kỳ + kho — không thể chạy lại", "statusCode": 409, "path": "/api/v2/price-calc-runs/90123/recalc", "timestamp": "2026-07-22T11:30:00Z" } } }
```

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|

| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | `runScope` không thuộc enum; `ERROR_ONLY` khi source run không có item ERROR (defensive) |
| `ERR-CMN-not-found` | 404 | Source run không tồn tại |
| `ERR-INV-024` | 409 | Period của source run CLOSED (BR-PRC-008 + AC-3) |
| `ERR-INV-029` | 409 | Run active cùng `(period+warehouse)` (BR-PRC-016 + AC-3b) |
| Thread pool exhausted | 503 | ADR-028 §Risk-3 |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Downstream timeout |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected |

#### Mutation `priceCalcRunDelete` (W06-5)

Soft-delete PRC log. **KHÔNG rollback giá vốn** phiếu xuất — chỉ ẩn log khỏi list (BR-PRC-011 + FEAT-PRC-DELETE AC-2).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant + branch; dual persona.
**Idempotency**: Repeat DELETE cùng `id` → 200 `{deleted: true}` với cached message (state terminal).

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-accounting` | `DELETE` | `/api/v2/price-calc-runs/{id}` |

**Request**:
```json

  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "X-Tenant-Id": "42",
    "X-Branch-Id": "1"
  },
  "operationName": "priceCalcRunDelete",
  "query": "mutation priceCalcRunDelete($id: Int!) { priceCalcRunDelete(id: $id) { __typename ... on PriceCalcRunDeleteApiResponse { data { runId deleted message } } ... on ErrorResponse { code message statusCode path timestamp } } }",
  "variables": { "id": 90123 }
}
```

**Response 200**:

```json
  "data": {
    "priceCalcRunDelete": {
      "__typename": "PriceCalcRunDeleteApiResponse",

        "runId": 90123,
        "deleted": true,
        "message": "Log tính giá đã được xóa. Giá vốn phiếu xuất giữ nguyên (không rollback)."
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "priceCalcRunDelete": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "code": "ERR-INV-029", "message": "Không thể xóa — lần tính đang chạy", "statusCode": 409, "path": "/api/v2/price-calc-runs/90123", "timestamp": "2026-07-22T10:15:00Z" } } }
```

**Error codes**:

|---|---:|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant mismatch; feature flag |
| `ERR-CMN-not-found` | 404 | Run không tồn tại |

| `ERR-INV-029` | 409 | Run `status ∈ {PENDING, RUNNING}` (BR-PRC-011 v13 + AC-4b) |

## 3j. Stock V2 Reports (DESIGN — W06, EP-INVENTORY-STOCK-V2)

> **Scope**: 3 GraphQL query passthrough sang `gf-inventory` public REST reports cho 3 màn báo cáo:
> - `stockLedgerAtDate` — FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 "Báo cáo tồn kho đến ngày" (web + mobile).
> - `stockInoutSummary` — FEAT-IP-VIEW-V2 "Báo cáo Nhập-Xuất-Tồn" (web-only).
> - `stockCardDetail` — FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 "Thẻ kho" per mã (web-only).
>
> **Naming Registry**: BFF `-graphql.md` KHÔNG lặp registry — reference [`gf-inventory-api.md §5.2 Stock Ledger`](gf-inventory-api.md) cho canonical field names (`movementDate`, `openingQty/Value` (v7.79 add, `StockCardDetailRow` per-row), `inboundQty/Value`, `outboundQty/Value`, `closingQty/Value`). Report-facing shapes SDL dưới đây thêm dimension fields `productCode` + `productName` + `mainUnitCode` + `warehouseCode` + `warehouseName` (canonical per Slip V2 §5.4.2/§5.4.3 và OB §5.1).
>
> **REST downstream ratification status**: 3 REST endpoints authored in `gf-inventory-api.md §3g.2 W06-STK-Q1..Q3` (v64 backfill 2026-07-23) + Naming Registry §5.2 read-side canonical finalized. **v7.77 (R8 2026-07-23)**: paths flipped `GET /api/v*/stock-ledgers/at-date` → `POST /api/v*/stock-ledgers/at-date/search` + siblings — per codebase majority convention for filter + paginated search endpoints (`gf-customer`, `gf-sales`, `gf-marketing`, `gf-erp-mdm`, `gf-accounting-api W06-1 price-calc-runs/search`). GraphQL Query type UNCHANGED (Query semantics independent of downstream REST verb). Response envelope + `context`/`opening`/`aggregates` blocks + error codes + pagination UNCHANGED — pure request-transport flip.
>
> **Naming precedent drift** (T6 soft flag, không STOP — user đã ratify GraphQL op names trong Round 2 mandate 2026-07-22): `gf-inventory-api.md v63 §5.2` forward-reference đã dùng names `stockOnHandReport / inventoryMovementReport / stockCardReport` cho GraphQL surface. Round 2 mandate rename thành `stockLedgerAtDate / stockInoutSummary / stockCardDetail` (semantic-clearer VN → EN). Delivery Authority cascade CR sẽ align `gf-inventory-api.md §5.2` note.

### 3j.1 SDL types

```graphql
"Dòng báo cáo tồn kho đến ngày — 1 row per (productCode + warehouseCode). Canonical fields per gf-inventory-api.md §5.2 + OB §5.1."
type StockLedgerAtDateRow {
  productCode: String!
  productName: String!
  mainUnitCode: String!
  "v7.82 GAP-1 add — BFF enrichment qua gf-erp-mdm directory=UNIT (BR-AGG-GARAGE-GRAPH-001 pattern, mirror InternalProduct.mainUnitDisplayName). Nullable — resolve null nếu code không match directory."
  mainUnitDisplayName: String
  warehouseCode: String!
  warehouseName: String!
  "Số lượng tồn đến ngày (từ sổ tồn realtime, dòng gần nhất ≤ asOfDate)."
  quantityOnHand: Decimal!
  "Giá trị tồn = GT đầu + GT nhập − giá vốn xuất. Pre-PWA giá vốn=0 nên GT xuất = 0."
  valueOnHand: Decimal!
}

"Dòng báo cáo NXT — 1 row per (productCode + warehouseCode). 4 nhóm cột (Đầu kỳ / Nhập / Xuất / Cuối kỳ) × 2 (SL + GT)."
type StockInoutSummaryRow {
  productCode: String!
  "v7.83 CR-20260731-04 add — numeric id cho FE navigation Link đến internal-product detail (FEAT-IP-VIEW-V2 AC-6). BFF-anticipatory, KHÔNG round-trip complete: REST DTO gf-inventory (stockInoutSummary W06-STK-Q2) CHƯA project field tương ứng — resolve null cho tới khi backend + resolver bổ sung (follow-up riêng, mirror pattern v7.80/v7.81 InheritedReceiptLine/InheritedDeliveryLine.sku)."
  productId: Int
  productName: String!
  mainUnitCode: String!
  "v7.82 GAP-1 add — same enrichment pattern as StockLedgerAtDateRow.mainUnitDisplayName (mirror consistency across 3 sibling report rows, same canonical dimension fields per §3j.1 prelude)."
  mainUnitDisplayName: String
  warehouseCode: String!
  warehouseName: String!
  openingQty: Decimal!
  openingValue: Decimal!
  inboundQty: Decimal!
  inboundValue: Decimal!
  outboundQty: Decimal!
  outboundValue: Decimal!
  closingQty: Decimal!
  closingValue: Decimal!
}

"Dòng thẻ kho — 1 row per phiếu nhập/xuất thật (SLIP). v7.79: bỏ dòng ảo OPENING + row-type OB_IMPORT + field movementKind (redesign per gf-inventory-api v71 CR-20260724-03 — mirror REST content[] shape 1:1)."
type StockCardDetailRow {
  movementDate: Date!
  "Mã phiếu (source slip) — luôn có giá trị thật (content[] chỉ còn phiếu SLIP, v7.79)."
  slipCode: String!
  "Loại phiếu (RECEIPT_* | DELIVERY_*) — đủ thể hiện nhập/xuất, không cần field movementKind riêng (v7.79)."
  slipType: String!
  "Đầu kỳ của chính dòng này (v7.79 add) — dòng thật đầu tiên = seed từ ledger point-lookup (mirror StockCardDetailOpening); dòng sau = closingQty/closingValue dòng liền trước. BE-computed trong RAM cho toàn filtered range trước khi cắt trang → pagination-safe. Non-null."
  openingQty: Decimal!
  openingValue: Decimal!
  inboundQty: Decimal!
  inboundValue: Decimal!
  outboundQty: Decimal!
  outboundValue: Decimal!
  closingQty: Decimal!
  closingValue: Decimal!
}

"v7.75 F-02 add — Q3 top-level context object (returned once per response, NOT per-row). Cheaper than denormalizing since (mã+kho) fixed cho toàn view per FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 AC-1."
type StockCardDetailContext {
  productCode: String!
  productName: String!
  mainUnitCode: String!
  "v7.82 GAP-1 add — same enrichment pattern as StockLedgerAtDateRow.mainUnitDisplayName."
  mainUnitDisplayName: String
  warehouseCode: String!
  warehouseName: String!
}

"v7.75 F-03 add — Q3 opening snapshot returned always (incl. no-movement case) per FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 AC-4."
type StockCardDetailOpening {
  openingQty: Decimal!
  openingValue: Decimal!
}

"v7.75 F-10 add — Q3 aggregates dòng Tổng BE-computed across full filtered range (mirror Q1/Q2 pattern)."
type StockCardDetailAggregates {
  openingQty: Decimal!

  totalInboundValue: Decimal!
  totalOutboundQty: Decimal!
  totalOutboundValue: Decimal!
  closingQty: Decimal!
  closingValue: Decimal!
}

"Aggregate footer — dòng Tổng bảng báo cáo."

}
type StockInoutSummaryAggregates {

}

"Input types"
input StockLedgerAtDateInput {

"Response wrappers."
type PagedStockLedgerAtDateApiResponse { data: PagedStockLedgerAtDateData }

}

}

  "v7.75 F-02 add — top-level context object (once per response, not per-row)."

  opening: StockCardDetailOpening!

  "v7.75 F-10 add — BE-computed dòng Tổng (mirror Q1/Q2 aggregates pattern)."
  aggregates: StockCardDetailAggregates!

  totalPages: Int!
  page: Int!
  size: Int!
}

"v7.75 F-04 add — 3 export operations (Q1/Q2/Q3 xuất file `.xlsx`) — BFF passthrough gf-inventory public REST W06-STK-EX1/EX2/EX3. Response = base64 string (binary payload) with metadata. See gf-inventory-api.md §3g W06-STK-EX* for template binding + row cap + Semantics."
```

### 3j.3 Resolver discipline

> **F-16 v7.76 (Round 5) — Warehouse identifier convention (module-wide)**: Stock V2 Reports module dùng **dual identifier scheme intentionally**:
> - **Q1/Q2/EX1/EX2 (list/summary + exports)**: filter theo `warehouseIds: [Int!]` (numeric IDs — multi-select filter, empty = tất cả kho tenant).
> - **Q3/EX3 (thẻ kho drill-down)**: lookup theo `warehouseCode: String!` (business code — single warehouse cần xác định chính xác cho movement timeline).
> - **Q1 → Q3 drill-down**: FE dùng `Q1 row.warehouseCode` field (co-emitted với `row.warehouseId`) làm arg cho Q3. Same convention Q2 → Q3.
> - **Resolver KHÔNG convert ID↔code** — pass verbatim theo BE canonical. `warehouseId` (numeric) và `warehouseCode` (string) đều là first-class identifier ở REST layer (`gf-inventory-api.md §3g`); BFF không introduce mapping helper.

- **Passthrough thuần** (v7.77 R8 verb split — read/paginated vs export):
  - **Q1/Q2/Q3 (read + paginated)**: resolver gọi `PassthroughService.request({ downstream: 'gf-inventory', method: 'POST', path: '{resource}/search', headers, body: JSON })` — GraphQL `input` variables forwarded verbatim as REST **JSON request body** per codebase majority convention for filter + paginated search endpoints. KHÔNG cache BFF-side — realtime read từ sổ tồn per FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 AC-3.
  - **EX1/EX2/EX3 (exports)**: resolver gọi `PassthroughService.request({ downstream: 'gf-inventory', method: 'GET', path, headers, query })` — filter params still forwarded as REST **query string** (export has no pagination, GET benefits from `<a href>` browser-download UX per v65 F-04). No behavior change vs pre-R8.
- **`mainUnitDisplayName` enrichment (v7.82 GAP-1 add)** — module KHÔNG còn "passthrough thuần" tuyệt đối cho field này: `gf-inventory` chỉ trả `mainUnitCode` raw (business code, vd `"PCS"`/`"CAI"` — canonical per `gf-inventory-data-model.md` + `gf-inventory-api.md §5.2` sample) chứ KHÔNG có display name tiếng Việt (vd "Cái") mà Figma render cho cột "ĐVT chính"/"ĐVT" ở cả 3 màn (`wave06-stk-list-v2.md`, `wave06-ip-view-v2.md`, `wave06-stk-detail-v2.md`). Resolver Q1/Q2/Q3 thêm 1 bước enrichment **sau** passthrough, cùng pattern `BR-AGG-GARAGE-GRAPH-001` đã dùng cho `InternalProduct.mainUnitDisplayName` (§3d.3): gom tất cả `mainUnitCode` distinct trong `content[]` (Q1/Q2) hoặc `context.mainUnitCode` (Q3) → batch query `gf-erp-mdm` `POST /api/v1/catalog/inquiry` `{directory: "UNIT", codes: [...]}` → map `code → name` vào field `mainUnitDisplayName`. Resolver **reuse in-process cache** (5min TTL, key `UNIT::{tenantId}`) đã có sẵn từ `catalog-v2.enrichment.ts` (§3d.3 `listUnits`/`fetchAllUnits()`) — không tạo lookup client riêng. Trả `null` khi code không match directory (đồng nhất semantic với `InternalProduct.mainUnitDisplayName`).
- **Aggregates footer**: BE tính footer `aggregates.total*` và trả trong cùng response — BFF không tự tính lại (avoid double-count paged rows).
- **`warehouseIds` array param — dual wire format** (v7.77 R8 update — R8 flip Q1/Q2 body split from EX1/EX2 query):
  - **Q1/Q2 (POST body)**: BFF forward GraphQL `warehouseIds: [Int!]` array **verbatim as JSON array** `"warehouseIds": [12, 13, 14]` inside REST POST body — native representation, no wire-format ambiguity. Aligns `gf-inventory-api.md §3g` Q1/Q2 Request body block (v67).
  - **EX1/EX2 (GET query string)**: BFF forward array as **multi-value repeated key** `?warehouseIds=12&warehouseIds=13&warehouseIds=14` (NOT CSV `?warehouseIds=12,13,14`) — RESTful convention + Spring `List<Integer>` native binding. F-16 v7.76 wire-format tightening still applies to exports (unchanged v65+ EX1/EX2 doc). Nếu tenant có multi-warehouse selection UI (AC-4 "Kho chọn tất cả / nhiều kho") — array phải support.
- **Feature flag**: cùng gate `Inventory:InventoryV2` áp BE-side; BFF không check.
- **Read-only**: KHÔNG có mutation trong module này.
- **Rate limit / bulkhead**: reports có thể tính heavy; BE nên có timeout 10s + `gf-inventory` bulkhead per tenant. BFF forward timeout `TIMEOUT_ERROR` khi vượt.

### 3j.4 Web + Mobile scope

- **Web GMS**: 3/3 ops SUPPORTED — FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 (tab "Báo cáo tồn kho") + FEAT-IP-VIEW-V2 (tab "Báo cáo NXT") + FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 (drill-down "Xem lịch sử" from FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 action column).
- **Mobile (App Garage)**: **CHỈ `stockLedgerAtDate` (W06-STK-Q1)** — FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 mobile scope. FEAT-IP-VIEW-V2 + FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 KHÔNG có mobile UI (per FEAT `Platform scope: Web GMS only`). Mobile hub tile "Tồn kho" (per FEAT-INV-MOBILE-MENU state matrix W06) chỉ mở FEAT-STK-LIST-V2; KHÔNG expose "Báo cáo NXT" / "Thẻ kho" ở mobile.
- **Cross-wave state matrix**: FEAT-INV-MOBILE-MENU tile "Tồn kho" (row 5 state matrix v2) flip từ `HIDDEN` (W05) → `VISIBLE` (W06) — pure feature-flag/state-matrix update, KHÔNG design UI riêng. Mobile hub base ship W04 per `INTEG-MOB §3.4b`.

### 3j.5 Operation count footer

Total W06 Stock V2 Reports operations: **6 ops** (v7.75 F-04 +3 export) — 6 Query (`stockLedgerAtDate`, `stockInoutSummary`, `stockCardDetail`, `stockLedgerAtDateExport`, `stockInoutSummaryExport`, `stockCardDetailExport`). Zero mutation. Rows 366-371 §2 Endpoint Summary.

**SDL query definitions** (v7.75 F-04 add — 3 export queries; input types reuse existing sibling `StockLedgerAtDateInput`/`StockInoutSummaryInput`/`StockCardDetailInput` minus `page`/`size` — export dump full filtered set, no pagination):

```graphql
extend type Query {
  """
  Xuất file .xlsx báo cáo tồn kho tại 1 mốc ngày. FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 AC-8. Web + mobile (mobile pending — soft flag).
  Passthrough gf-inventory W06-STK-EX1 GET /api/v1/stock-ledgers/at-date/export.
  """
  stockLedgerAtDateExport(input: StockLedgerAtDateExportInput!): StockReportExportApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Xuất file .xlsx báo cáo NXT. FEAT-IP-VIEW-V2 AC-7. Web-only. Passthrough W06-STK-EX2."""
  stockInoutSummaryExport(input: StockInoutSummaryExportInput!): StockReportExportApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Xuất file .xlsx báo cáo thẻ kho. FEAT-STK-DETAIL-V2 AC-7. Web-only. Passthrough W06-STK-EX3."""
  stockCardDetailExport(input: StockCardDetailExportInput!): StockReportExportApiResponse! @requiresAuth
}

"Export input types — same shape as query siblings minus page/size (export = full filtered set with defensive row cap at gf-inventory)."
input StockLedgerAtDateExportInput {
  asOfDate: Date!
  warehouseIds: [Int!]
  keyword: String
  sort: String = "productCode,asc"
}
input StockInoutSummaryExportInput {
  fromDate: Date!
  toDate: Date!
  warehouseIds: [Int!]
  keyword: String
  sort: String = "productCode,asc"
}
input StockCardDetailExportInput {
  productCode: String!
  warehouseCode: String!
  fromDate: Date!
  toDate: Date!
}
```

#### Query `stockLedgerAtDate` (W06-STK-Q1)

Báo cáo tồn kho đến 1 mốc ngày. Multi-warehouse filter. FEAT-STK-LIST-V2 AC-1..AC-5.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant + branch.
**Idempotency**: Read-only.

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-inventory` | `POST` | `/api/v*/stock-ledgers/at-date/search` (JSON body per `gf-inventory-api.md §3g.2 W06-STK-Q1` v67 — filter+pagination in body: `{asOfDate, warehouseIds[], keyword, page, size, sort}`) |

**Error codes**:

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|

| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected (template render fail) |

**Resolver discipline**: BFF passthrough — reads downstream binary bytes, encodes base64, wraps in `StockReportExportPayload`. Content-Disposition header from downstream forwarded via `fileName` field. Client decodes + triggers browser download via `<a href="data:...;base64,...">`.

## 3k. Partner Link — Driver Plus (DESIGN — W07, EP-PARTNER-LINK)

> **Scope**: 6 GraphQL operation **passthrough thuần** sang `gf-system` public REST `/api/v1/system/partner-links*` cho menu/tab "Liên kết" tab "Driver Plus". Cùng 1 BFF phục vụ **cả Web GMS và Mobile app** — KHÔNG có BFF/API riêng cho mobile (`EP-PARTNER-LINK` §5.2).
>
> **Naming Registry**: BFF file này **KHÔNG lặp** registry — reference [`gf-system-api.md` §5](gf-system-api.md) cho canonical field/enum/path-param names (Phase 5b rule).
>
> **Backend**: 6 endpoint REST authored tại [`gf-system-api.md` v3 §3bis](gf-system-api.md). Quyết định kiến trúc: [ADR-029](../decisions/ADR-029-driver-plus-kafka-adapter-on-gf-system.md) (giao thức Driver Plus) + [ADR-030](../decisions/ADR-030-tenant-profile-sot-on-gf-system.md) (hồ sơ garage SoT).
>
> **KHÔNG có operation tạo yêu cầu liên kết** — record `LKD-YYYY-NNN` chỉ sinh từ inbound Kafka event Driver Plus (`BR-DPL-CMN-001`). Đây là chủ ý, không phải thiếu sót.

### 3k.1 SDL types

```graphql
"Trạng thái yêu cầu liên kết đối tác. 4 giá trị — BR-GF-SYSTEM.md §3.2."
enum PartnerLinkStatus {
  "Chờ liên kết (badge cam)"
  PENDING
  "Đã liên kết (badge xanh lá)"
  LINKED
  "Từ chối (badge đỏ, terminal)"
  REJECTED
  "Đã hủy liên kết (badge đỏ đậm, terminal)"
  UNLINKED
}

"Đối tác ngoài. Giai đoạn 1 hard-code 1 giá trị — FEAT §7 Out of Scope."
enum PartnerCode {
  DRIVER_PLUS
}

"Nút hành động khả dụng — server-derived theo status (FEAT AC-8). FE render nút theo mảng này, KHÔNG tự suy từ status."
enum PartnerLinkAction {
  APPROVE
  REJECT
  RESYNC
  CANCEL
}

"1 dòng trong danh sách yêu cầu liên kết (web panel trái AC-4 / mobile card AC-41)."
type PartnerLinkRequest {
  requestCode: String!
  partnerCode: PartnerCode!
  partnerAccountName: String!
  partnerAccountPhone: String!
  requestedAt: DateTime!
  status: PartnerLinkStatus!
  processedAt: DateTime
  "Snapshot text `{Tên} ({Role})` hoặc hằng `Driver Plus` — BR-DPL-CMN-005. Mobile card hiển thị trực tiếp (BR-DPL-LST-005)."
  processedByLabel: String
  "Lý do Từ chối/Hủy; null khi PENDING hoặc khi Duyệt. Mobile card hiển thị trực tiếp."
  reason: String
}

"Khối THÔNG TIN DOANH NGHIỆP + ĐỊA CHỈ — đọc real-time từ gf-system tenant_profile (CB-SYS-006). Nullable khi tenant chưa có hồ sơ (ADR-030 Gap 2) — UI render rỗng, KHÔNG chặn action."
type PartnerLinkGarageProfile {
  businessName: String
  contactPhoneNumber: String
  addressDetail: String
  ward: String
  city: String
}

"Khối THÔNG TIN XUẤT HOÁ ĐƠN — 4 field cố định, đọc real-time từ tenant_invoice_info (FEAT AC-11)."
type PartnerLinkInvoiceInfo {
  companyName: String
  taxCode: String
  "Địa chỉ pháp lý trên hoá đơn — 1 chuỗi đơn, KHÁC addressDetail của garageProfile (FEAT AC-11 iii)."
  companyAddress: String
  companyEmailAddress: String
}

"Chi tiết yêu cầu liên kết (web panel phải AC-8..AC-11 / mobile màn chi tiết full-screen)."
type PartnerLinkRequestDetail {
  requestCode: String!
  partnerCode: PartnerCode!
  partnerAccountName: String!
  partnerAccountPhone: String!
  requestedAt: DateTime!
  status: PartnerLinkStatus!
  processedAt: DateTime
  processedByLabel: String
  reason: String
  availableActions: [PartnerLinkAction!]!
  garageProfile: PartnerLinkGarageProfile
  invoiceInfo: PartnerLinkInvoiceInfo
}

"Kết quả 3 mutation đổi state (approve / reject / cancel)."
type PartnerLinkActionResult {
  requestCode: String!
  status: PartnerLinkStatus!
  processedAt: DateTime!
  processedByLabel: String!
  reason: String
  availableActions: [PartnerLinkAction!]!
  "Chỉ có giá trị ở approve — danh sách record bị cascade auto-reject (FEAT AC-16). Rỗng khi không có."
  autoRejectedRequestCodes: [String!]!
}

"Kết quả Đồng bộ lại — state KHÔNG đổi (BR-DPL-SYN-002), trả lại bản hồ sơ vừa đẩy đi để FE refresh section C."
type PartnerLinkResyncResult {
  requestCode: String!
  status: PartnerLinkStatus!
  processedAt: DateTime
  processedByLabel: String
  reason: String
  availableActions: [PartnerLinkAction!]!
  syncedAt: DateTime!
  garageProfile: PartnerLinkGarageProfile
  invoiceInfo: PartnerLinkInvoiceInfo
}

"Wrapper danh sách — KHÔNG phân trang (BR-DPL-LST-004 deviation có chủ đích); truncated=true khi vượt cap 500 phòng vệ của gf-system."
type PartnerLinkRequestList {
  items: [PartnerLinkRequest!]!
  "Mobile render tiêu đề '{N} yêu cầu' (FEAT AC-41)."
  totalItems: Int!
  truncated: Boolean!
}

"Inputs"
input PartnerLinkRequestFilterInput {
  "Default DRIVER_PLUS khi bỏ trống."
  partnerCode: PartnerCode = DRIVER_PLUS
  "Bỏ trống = tất cả 4 trạng thái. FE gửi mặc định [PENDING, LINKED] — BR-DPL-LST-003."
  statuses: [PartnerLinkStatus!]
}

input ApprovePartnerLinkInput {
  "Bắt buộc true — consent điều khoản chia sẻ (BR-DPL-APV-002). Server guard, độc lập gate UI checkbox + scroll-to-end."
  termsAccepted: Boolean!
}

input PartnerLinkReasonInput {
  "Bắt buộc, trim không rỗng (BR-DPL-REJ-002 / BR-DPL-CAN-002). Không có min-length; max 2000."
  reason: String!
}

extend type Query {
  """Danh sách yêu cầu liên kết của garage hiện tại. FEAT AC-3..AC-7 (web) + AC-41/AC-42 (mobile). Passthrough gf-system GET /api/v1/system/partner-links."""
  listPartnerLinkRequests(input: PartnerLinkRequestFilterInput): PartnerLinkRequestListApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Chi tiết 1 yêu cầu + khối đồng bộ đọc real-time. FEAT AC-8..AC-11. Passthrough GET /api/v1/system/partner-links/{requestCode}."""
  getPartnerLinkRequestDetail(requestCode: String!): PartnerLinkRequestDetailApiResponse! @requiresAuth
}

extend type Mutation {
  """Duyệt yêu cầu (Chờ liên kết → Đã liên kết) + cascade auto-reject. FEAT AC-15/AC-16. Passthrough POST .../approve."""
  approvePartnerLinkRequest(requestCode: String!, input: ApprovePartnerLinkInput!): PartnerLinkActionApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Từ chối yêu cầu kèm lý do bắt buộc. FEAT AC-19. Passthrough POST .../reject."""
  rejectPartnerLinkRequest(requestCode: String!, input: PartnerLinkReasonInput!): PartnerLinkActionApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Đồng bộ lại hồ sơ garage sang D+ — KHÔNG đổi state. FEAT AC-21. Passthrough POST .../resync."""
  resyncPartnerLinkData(requestCode: String!): PartnerLinkResyncApiResponse! @requiresAuth

  """Hủy liên kết kèm lý do bắt buộc (Đã liên kết → Đã hủy liên kết). FEAT AC-24. Passthrough POST .../cancel."""
  cancelPartnerLink(requestCode: String!, input: PartnerLinkReasonInput!): PartnerLinkActionApiResponse! @requiresAuth
}

"Response unions — theo pattern ErrorResponse sẵn có của gateway."
union PartnerLinkRequestListApiResponse = PartnerLinkRequestListPayload | ErrorResponse
union PartnerLinkRequestDetailApiResponse = PartnerLinkRequestDetailPayload | ErrorResponse
union PartnerLinkActionApiResponse = PartnerLinkActionPayload | ErrorResponse
union PartnerLinkResyncApiResponse = PartnerLinkResyncPayload | ErrorResponse

type PartnerLinkRequestListPayload { data: PartnerLinkRequestList! }
type PartnerLinkRequestDetailPayload { data: PartnerLinkRequestDetail! }
type PartnerLinkActionPayload { data: PartnerLinkActionResult! }
type PartnerLinkResyncPayload { data: PartnerLinkResyncResult! }
```

### 3k.3 Resolver discipline

- **Passthrough thuần** — resolver gọi `PassthroughService.request({ downstream: 'gf-system', method, path, headers, query|body })`. **KHÔNG** orchestrate, **KHÔNG** business logic, **KHÔNG** compose nhiều downstream. Toàn bộ state guard / cascade / invariant nằm ở `gf-system` (partial unique index + 1 transaction — `gf-system-api.md` §3bis).
- **Headers forward**: `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Branch-Id` (nếu client gửi), `x-request-id`. Gateway **không** issue JWT và **không** own authorization — `gf-system` resolve tenant từ security context.
- **KHÔNG cache** (`fetchPolicy: no-cache` phía client, không LRU phía BFF) cho `getPartnerLinkRequestDetail` — khối `garageProfile`/`invoiceInfo` bắt buộc real-time (CB-SYS-006 + `BR-DPL-SYN-002`). `listPartnerLinkRequests` cũng không cache: state có thể đổi ngầm do inbound event Driver Plus (FEAT AC-33/AC-35 "UI cập nhật ngầm").
- **KHÔNG enrichment** — khác `§3d`/`§3j` (có bước enrich display-name qua `gf-erp-mdm`): mọi field hiển thị đã ở dạng cuối trong response `gf-system` (`processedByLabel` là snapshot text; nhãn trạng thái do FE map từ enum theo `gf-system-api.md` §5.2).
- **Error passthrough**: map HTTP status → union `ErrorResponse` với `code` giữ **verbatim** mã từ `gf-system` (`ERR-DPL-*` hoặc `GMS.gf-system.PARTNER_LINK.*`) — BFF **KHÔNG** đổi tên mã, FE/mobile bind message theo `ERROR-CODE-REGISTRY.md` §5.
- **Feature flag** `PartnerLink:DriverPlus`: gate ở BE (`gf-system` trả 403 `GMS.gf-system.PARTNER_LINK.FLAG_OFF`); BFF **không** tự check. FE/mobile ẩn menu/tab dựa trên `featureFlags` query sẵn có (row #37 §2).
- **Read-only cho `listPartnerLinkRequests`**: không có mutation nào tạo record (`BR-DPL-CMN-001`).

### 3k.4 Web + Mobile scope

- **Web GMS**: 6/6 ops SUPPORTED — menu top-nav "Liên kết" → tab "Driver Plus", layout master-detail (`FEAT` AC-1..AC-3).
- **Mobile (App Garage)**: **6/6 ops SUPPORTED** — tab bottom-nav "Liên kết", danh sách dạng card + màn Bộ lọc full-screen + màn chi tiết full-screen (`FEAT` Nhóm N, AC-40..AC-42). **Khác biệt UI thuần FE** — cùng operation, cùng shape, không có op riêng cho mobile. Card mobile hiển thị thêm `processedByLabel` + `reason` (đã có sẵn trong `PartnerLinkRequest`, không cần field mới — `BR-DPL-LST-005`).
- **Tab "Đối tác khác"**: placeholder, **KHÔNG** có operation (`EP-PARTNER-LINK` §7 Out of Scope).

### 3k.5 Operation count footer

Total W07 Partner Link operations: **6 ops** — 2 Query (`listPartnerLinkRequests`, `getPartnerLinkRequestDetail`) + 4 Mutation (`approvePartnerLinkRequest`, `rejectPartnerLinkRequest`, `resyncPartnerLinkData`, `cancelPartnerLink`). Rows 372-377 §2 Endpoint Summary.

### 3k.6 Endpoint Details

#### Query `listPartnerLinkRequests` (W07-PL-Q1)

Danh sách yêu cầu liên kết của garage hiện tại, lọc theo trạng thái. `FEAT` AC-4/AC-5 (web) · AC-41/AC-42 (mobile).

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant. Dual persona `garage-owner` | `accountant` ngang quyền (`BR-DPL-CMN-004`).
**Idempotency**: Read-only.

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-system` | `GET` | `/api/v1/system/partner-links?partnerCode=DRIVER_PLUS&statuses=PENDING&statuses=LINKED` (`statuses` = multi-value repeated key, KHÔNG CSV) |

**Request**:
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "X-Tenant-Id": "5001"
  },
  "operationName": "listPartnerLinkRequests",
  "query": "query listPartnerLinkRequests($input: PartnerLinkRequestFilterInput) { listPartnerLinkRequests(input: $input) { __typename ... on PartnerLinkRequestListPayload { data { items { requestCode partnerCode partnerAccountName partnerAccountPhone requestedAt status processedAt processedByLabel reason } totalItems truncated } } ... on ErrorResponse { code message statusCode path timestamp } } }",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "partnerCode": "DRIVER_PLUS",
      "statuses": ["PENDING", "LINKED"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "listPartnerLinkRequests": {
      "__typename": "PartnerLinkRequestListPayload",
      "data": {
        "items": [
          {
            "requestCode": "LKD-2026-002",
            "partnerCode": "DRIVER_PLUS",
            "partnerAccountName": "Trần Thị Mai",
            "partnerAccountPhone": "0912345678",
            "requestedAt": "2026-08-05T03:09:58Z",
            "status": "PENDING",
            "processedAt": null,
            "processedByLabel": null,
            "reason": null
          }
        ],
        "totalItems": 1,
        "truncated": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "listPartnerLinkRequests": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "code": "ERR-DPL-007", "message": "Không tải được danh sách yêu cầu liên kết. Vui lòng thử lại.", "statusCode": 503, "path": "/api/v1/system/partner-links", "timestamp": "2026-08-05T03:10:00Z" } } }
```

**Error codes**:

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant không resolve được |
| `GMS.gf-system.PARTNER_LINK.FLAG_OFF` | 403 | Feature flag `PartnerLink:DriverPlus` = off → FE/mobile ẩn menu/tab |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | `statuses` chứa giá trị ngoài enum; `partnerCode` ≠ `DRIVER_PLUS` |
| `ERR-DPL-007` | 503 | Lỗi đọc DB — FE render banner + nút "Tải lại" (UX-FLOW §4) |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` | 504 | Downstream timeout |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected |

> **Empty state**: `items: []` + `totalItems: 0` là **200 hợp lệ**, KHÔNG phải lỗi. FE phân biệt 2 message theo filter đang áp: chưa từng có yêu cầu → `ERR-DPL-008`; filter loại hết → `ERR-DPL-009` (`FEAT` AC-7 vs EC-1).

#### Mutation `approvePartnerLinkRequest` (W07-PL-M1)

Duyệt yêu cầu "Chờ liên kết". Server chuyển state + cascade auto-reject các "Chờ liên kết" khác **trong 1 transaction** + ghi outbox 2 loại event. `FEAT` AC-15 + AC-16.

**Transport**: `POST /graphql`.
**Auth**: authenticated + tenant. Dual persona ngang quyền.
**Idempotency**: state-guarded ở BE (`WHERE status='PENDING'`) — gọi lặp trả `409 ERR-DPL-004`, KHÔNG tạo liên kết thứ hai. **KHÔNG** dùng `Idempotency-Key` header.

**Downstream**:

| Service | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| `gf-system` | `POST` | `/api/v1/system/partner-links/{requestCode}/approve` (body `{ "termsAccepted": true }`) |

**Request**:
```json
{
  "headers": {
    "Authorization": "Bearer <access-token>",
    "X-Tenant-Id": "5001"
  },
  "operationName": "approvePartnerLinkRequest",
  "query": "mutation approvePartnerLinkRequest($requestCode: String!, $input: ApprovePartnerLinkInput!) { approvePartnerLinkRequest(requestCode: $requestCode, input: $input) { __typename ... on PartnerLinkActionPayload { data { requestCode status processedAt processedByLabel reason availableActions autoRejectedRequestCodes } } ... on ErrorResponse { code message statusCode path timestamp } } }",
  "variables": {
    "requestCode": "LKD-2026-001",
    "input": { "termsAccepted": true }
  }
}
```

**Response 200**:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "approvePartnerLinkRequest": {
      "__typename": "PartnerLinkActionPayload",
      "data": {
        "requestCode": "LKD-2026-001",
        "status": "LINKED",
        "processedAt": "2026-08-05T04:00:00Z",
        "processedByLabel": "Đăng Vinh (Chủ garage)",
        "reason": null,
        "availableActions": ["RESYNC", "CANCEL"],
        "autoRejectedRequestCodes": ["LKD-2026-002", "LKD-2026-003"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Error response shape**:
```json
{ "data": { "approvePartnerLinkRequest": { "__typename": "ErrorResponse", "code": "ERR-DPL-006", "message": "Đã có tài khoản Driver Plus khác vừa được liên kết. Yêu cầu của bạn tự động chuyển \"Từ chối\".", "statusCode": 409, "path": "/api/v1/system/partner-links/LKD-2026-001/approve", "timestamp": "2026-08-05T04:00:00Z" } } }
```

**Error codes**:

| Code | HTTP | Condition |
|---|---:|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED_ERROR` / `FORBIDDEN_ERROR` | 401 / 403 | Auth; tenant không resolve được |
| `GMS.gf-system.PARTNER_LINK.FLAG_OFF` | 403 | Feature flag off |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | 400 | `termsAccepted` ≠ `true` (`BR-DPL-APV-002`) hoặc `requestCode` sai pattern |
| `GMS.gf-system.PARTNER_LINK.NF_404` | 404 | Không tìm thấy record |
| `ERR-DPL-004` | 409 | Record không còn `PENDING` — FE toast "…đã được xử lý bởi người dùng khác" + refresh (`FEAT` AC-27) |
| `ERR-DPL-006` | 409 | Race 2 user Duyệt 2 record khác nhau — record của user này đã tự chuyển `REJECTED` (`FEAT` AC-31) |
| `ERR-DPL-005` | 503 | Lỗi hệ thống — modal giữ nguyên dữ liệu user nhập (`FEAT` AC-29) |
| `TIMEOUT_ERROR` / `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 504 / 500 | Downstream timeout / unexpected |
